| Hi Peter, can I tell you a quick story about this photo? [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/84393026/471360687/1999561158?amount=10&refcode=UD_20240505_EMSPL_E3_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzgxNTI4IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImE3NDFiNzRmLTNjMGItZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=IFq8B-Igz-b2t45wxTS6not1qcvHCPJCBLLrxcNx88Y=) That's me in 1985 — just 24 years old at my law school graduation, fresh off a student research assistant job for Professor Laurence Tribe, thinking that I had just completed the toughest challenge of my academic career. Well, up to that point, anyway. (The bar exam was still a few weeks away).

Some years later, I would become an Assistant United States Attorney, and successfully prosecute the first FBI agent charged with espionage, Richard Miller, for spying for the Soviet Union.

As a new graduate of law school, I could never have imagined I would handle a case like that.

Or that I would later investigate a president who also betrayed our country...

...lead his impeachment and Senate trial...

...serve on the January 6 Committee...

...get kicked off the Intelligence Committee by a craven Speaker of the House for doing the above...

...and get censured by extreme partisan MAGA House Republicans under the personal threat of that corrupt president...

Life leads us in uncertain and fortuitous ways. I’m fortunate that at a time when our country has been in trouble, and our democracy at risk, I have been in a position to help do something about it.

In the Senate, I hope to do even more.

[If you're able to, will you contribute a split donation of $10 between UNITEDemocrats and my campaign to help me reach the Senate, defend our majority, and defeat Trump? I would be grateful for your help in continuing my service.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/84393035/471360703/1999561158?amount=10&refcode=UD_20240505_EMSPL_E3_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzgxNTI4IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImE3NDFiNzRmLTNjMGItZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=IFq8B-Igz-b2t45wxTS6not1qcvHCPJCBLLrxcNx88Y=) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Adam Schiff and UNITEDemocrats will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://click.everyaction.com/k/84393044/471360716/1999561158?amount=10&amounts=10,15,20&express_lane=true&refcode=UD_20240505_EMSPL_E3_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzgxNTI4IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImE3NDFiNzRmLTNjMGItZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=IFq8B-Igz-b2t45wxTS6not1qcvHCPJCBLLrxcNx88Y=)

Unlike Rick Scott, I want to expand and protect the benefits that seniors like my mom have worked so hard their entire lives to earn.
| | |
---
Hi, friend — one of my favorite Sunday traditions is spending time with my mom, playing dominoes at the kitchen table.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84393207/471367100/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1167-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMWE5NzBmNjUtM2UwYi1lZjExLTk2ZjMtN2MxZTUyMWIwN2Y5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=etuLykFk2KOU57dIGLAyMTlhM9lzOYmQzUApkn5Tqjw=)
And frankly, she's the reason that I'm running for Senate in Florida now. My mom moved our family from Ecuador to pursue the American Dream, and in doing so, she inspired me to fight for a better life — not just for myself, but for those around me, too.
Thanks to her hard work and sacrifice,** that dream came true — and I went on to become the first South American immigrant elected to Congress.**
In recent years, I've also become her caretaker: a job I take just as much pride and joy in doing. I'm so grateful to be able to give her a good, stable retirement (and continuing our Sunday domino tradition is just the cherry on top!).
But friend, I recognize that it’s not this simple for everyone. It’s becoming more and more challenging for Americans to retire comfortably.
_The reason why?_**Politicians like my extremist opponent, Rick Scott.** They're dead-set on defunding essential programs like Medicare and Social Security — but Scott isn't content with just stopping there.
**In fact, he's the architect of the plan to SUNSET Social Security and Medicare plans**** in the next five years. **
Our seniors deserve to age with dignity — **and unlike Rick Scott, I want to **_expand_** and **_protect_** the benefits that seniors like my mom have worked so hard their entire lives to earn. **
**That’s why I’m running for Senate, and why I'm counting on help from supporters like you to retire** _him_**this November —** _[**so friend, will you please chip in to help me flip Florida blue, defend our Senate majority, and protect Social Security and Medicare benefits from heartless Republicans like Rick Scott?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84393208/471367117/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1167-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMWE5NzBmNjUtM2UwYi1lZjExLTk2ZjMtN2MxZTUyMWIwN2Y5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=etuLykFk2KOU57dIGLAyMTlhM9lzOYmQzUApkn5Tqjw=)_

body:
I fled Communist China for freedom. Now, I'm ready to fight to keep our freedom.

| [](http://links.gopindependent.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=1ed817ed14994b2799adebb49c79a9cd&_e=o3tlTNcDAHvU7_nCtcQGBCmGInTo95xnQcGQgzzqU1PgU4zYd7GDE5ieZLR9-sIz-mfCgLUZ6IKBOj6gkscDbfqUHaQE1adZoHkETgjzcJHrX3rBQl84igGkdZ8MSbHrUN-OFLhJFoJwnAr8UgmxPXQeiXSeUocaIuNoQwmEBT9qXDNns22ffNCMEWJ-SZPbYH_Ftng5GkPK4OxLQQmiIwfRTgfIseyHu70xJittM35f5jRqbk7gEWhD8TR1HwnKiC9sGam7bsUldAUM24sTJhRxZnd214NCZpdH9g-w4YTthWvRW-Eeq02r72tg_4VniXLwH1tH_T00l9XyUhk8QbrLuyAQ6Ija_KxL0MgLN1QDgTToM5JNkYKpTc4NlW7AV3DS4CCiMZ2Uj1ImKxHwnHnTcLjeETG4b9VSv3wRo9o%3D)
---
Fellow American, my name is Lily Tang Williams. **This is a picture of me in Chengdu, China, where I was born and lived under communist Mao Zedong's cruel "leadership" until he died in 1976, when I was twelve years old.**

I grew up in extremely poor living conditions where food rationing, social chaos, and indoctrination were normal. These hardships taught me to work hard, persevere, and reach for every opportunity I can.

As a young adult, I dreamed of America after reading the U.S. Constitution and the Declaration of Independence. These two documents taught me the importance of individual rights and liberty as opposed to collective rights.

_In 1988, I escaped the Communist Regime and came to America with only $100 borrowed in my pocket and $1,200 in debt to my sponsor. I could no longer in good conscience support the Chinese Communist Party (CCP). I was in desperate search of freedom and opportunity._

Although I was not fluent in English, I was determined to succeed in America. Shortly after, I graduated from the University of Texas at Austin with a Master's degree in Administration and Planning from the School of Social Work.

Soon after arriving in America, I met my husband, whom I've been with for almost 34 years. Together, we have three children, two of whom served our country in the military. While raising my family, in America, it became _crucial_ to me that Americans hear the horrors of Socialism and Communism.

| | Dear Fellow American, American civics education, and specifically the teaching of American history, is at a crisis point. In K-12 schools nationwide, false narratives are being constructed, and content is being cherry-picked to fit an ideological (and frankly anti-American) agenda. Maybe you've even seen this happening in your local schools. As a result, we are faced with a choice: will we allow our children to be indoctrinated using curricula developed by anti-American ideologues and promoted by Left-wing education bureaucrats? Or will we insist that our children are taught honestly, using a curriculum that presents a fair, unbiased, and comprehensive view of our nation's history? We must insist on the **latter** , both for the sake of truth and for the sake of our children and America's future. For this reason, we have produced the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ --and I'm writing to ask your help in promoting this curriculum to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide. **What is the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_? ** The**_Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_** is a K-12 history and civics curriculum that covers the triumphs and tragedies of American history fairly and comprehensively. This curriculum has been designed not by activists or ideologues but by teachers and professors at Hillsdale College--and we are making it available **free of charge**. To be clear, the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ is not a _slap-dash_ response to the efforts of anti-American ideologues to indoctrinate our children. It is a 2,000-page, 85-lesson curriculum based on decades of studying American history. Developed over 18 months of intense and focused effort, its roots extend as far back as the beginning of Hillsdale College in 1844. And we need your help to make the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ available to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide...and to make it available **free of charge** so that it will have the greatest impact. _We have set a budget goal of $800,000 to promote the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ and our other outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school initiative_. That's an ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible. One reason why your support really matters: **Hillsdale College refuses to accept one penny in taxpayer support --not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans**. This makes our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like you--citizens who agree with Hillsdale's mission on behalf of liberty. We remind ourselves daily of Hillsdale's 180-year-old mission--to provide "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty." With that mission in mind, we produced the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ --and now we need your help to promote it nationwide. Will you take this opportunity to _**support the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_ and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty**_**?** Understanding that a proper education is vital to the preservation of liberty--and that the anti-American indoctrination now being forced on too many American children poses an existential threat to liberty--I hope you will make your most generous tax-deductible gift today. **I 've included a secure link for your convenience here: ** _**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-hillsdale-1776-curriculum](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a349010d20014826ae5c9e1a5672f8f5&_e=2VG6Ckk5mxbsZC6xofDbBlAiL4vj-C8t8Zin3RCJ0tJY7WB-wGTqT7D5Th_JSCHPTrfw9CtSdDBJG5kesSgi6pig_nOkQ5wL4a_EhBnCfPgMozFNIUR-Lj5CzN59Mm2HzqoQc_544mq1-CdTxQ2AlZCgfGHbuPrPb2DUEtcgycpz1pQls-8wOa2z-9-btriKRkJ9zhqaooUpeBo8YF_JoISadKPeZ5vCv2O3MJmRxi4rlUH7MdKhFs6gAKplqWyXTCvUDpq-fsB1rJz3PlfHQFbIuB_JZ2T-PaYGScMdw7mKc6gEBofmAB-0TflWKVre11_2q9Fl38-v7QPtHnAn7mMd2IiwBjdNZK7Uj7qvfCR2V6hFvpAu2yD41THCEk0Vk64OgxF7mVA9QsCf3mIHpUFU6roRmK-dVhhOwRfmwB8%3D)**_ Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to hearing from you. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**May 5, 2024** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST** **By Heidi Ganahl**
| | Dear Readers,
As we approach the final week of the 2024 legislative session here in Colorado, here's a breakdown of the good and bad bills still left on the table, courtesy of [Kevin Lundberg](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) (you can read the full article [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for the very extensive list of bad bills):
**Good Bills:**
1. **[HB24-1022](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Publish Bill Drafts Online before Session:** This bill, which has passed the House, aims to enhance transparency by making upcoming bills available online for citizens to review before the session begins.
2. **[HB24-1142](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Reduce Income Tax Social Security Benefits:** Recognizing the importance of tax relief, this bill proposes a reduction in income tax on Social Security benefits, offering financial assistance to seniors. It has passed the House.
3. **[SB24-228](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) TABOR Refund Mechanisms:** This bill presents an alternative TABOR refund mechanism, potentially offering relief to taxpayers. While its implications are still being assessed, it has passed committee.

**Bad Bills:**
1. **[HB24-1075](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Analysis of Universal Health-Care Payment System:** This bill, passed by the Senate committee, raises concerns about its potential cost and impact on medical care quality, drawing comparisons to issues faced by the Canadian healthcare system.
2. **[HB24-1080](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Youth Sports Personnel Requirements:** Passing the Senate, this bill mandates additional reporting requirements.
3. **[HB24-1083](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Construction Professional Insurance Coverage Transparency:** Passed by the first committee, this bill introduces more red tape by requiring contractors and subcontractors to disclose workers' comp insurance, potentially increasing costs for everyone involved.
4. **[HB24-1124](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Discrimination in Places of Public Accommodation:** This bill, passed by the Senate, subjects nonprofit organizations to discrimination laws, raising concerns about potential ideological impositions.
5. **[HB24-1170](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Rights for Youth Division of Youth Services Facilities:** Passing the Senate, this bill introduces more transgender ideology into state statutes, sparking debates on societal values.

There are several more bad bills that are on the table. [See the full list here.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
As we navigate these legislative proposals, it's essential to stay informed and engaged in the democratic process. Your voice matters, and your participation in these discussions is crucial for shaping the future of our state.
Thank you for your attention, and I encourage you to reach out with any questions or concerns regarding these bills or any other legislative matters.
- Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **STATE**
---

Metro Denver's homeless crisis has worsened and become among the most acute in the nation despite the city of Denver contracting for at least $274 million from 2021 through 2024 to keep people off the streets.

In various debates in the 4th District, Boebert has noted the depredation by the gray wolf in Colorado, and had pledged to pursue a bill in Congress which would remove the gray wolf from the endangered species list.

Prosecutors filed additional charges this week against a former Littleton Public Schools bus aide accused of beating two nonverbal students, revealing more incidents of alleged abuse on their way to and from school.

## The Border War
---
My fellow citizens, Today, I write you with a heavy heart, burdened by the stark realities I witnessed firsthand at our nation's border. I embarked on a journey fueled by duty and curiosity, to delve into the depths of the border conflict that has gripped our nation's attention. What I encountered there was beyond comprehension, beyond what any of us could have imagined. In my pursuit of truth, I stumbled upon scenes that shook me to my core. I could not turn away, for it is our duty as leaders, as stewards of this great nation, to confront the harsh realities that confront us. With profound urgency, I present to you a brief glimpse into the depths of this crisis, a testament to the importance of addressing these challenges head-on. I implore each and every one of you to bear witness to this footage, to let it serve as a call to action, a rallying cry for compassion, for empathy, and for decisive action. Together, we can and we must confront the challenges that lie ahead, for the sake of our nation, for the sake of our humanity. Please, click the link below to view the video, and join me in the journey. I will be returning next week to spend a few days.

| | Dear Fellow American, The National Association of Intercollegiate Athletics (NAIA) just banned men who pretend to be women from competing in women’s sports.Now I’m asking you to sign this emergency petition demanding the National Collegiate Athletic Association – widely known as the NCAA – do the same. **[Will you take 30 seconds right now to add your name to the BAN MEN FROM WOMEN’S SPORTS Petition?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/E-J1Qwj1KWH410r1B-qCcQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoGzKkP0SUaHR0cHM6Ly9hbmVkb3QubGliZXJ0eWNlbnRlci5vcmcvNjQwZGQzMTgtNTNlYy00Njk3LThhZTUtZTNjY2E4MjQ0OGEwP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9QkRHLVJFTiZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPUVNJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI0MDUwNl9CREdfQ0ZBTF9OQ0FBX1JFTl9QQS1DQlcDc3BjQgpmM_OYOGbA20HlUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** My goal is to collect 1,000,000 signatures to send to NCAA President Charlie Baker in the next few weeks. As the attorney of three young women who were coerced by medical professionals into taking puberty-blocking drugs, pumping their bodies full of cross-sex hormones, and amputating their healthy breasts when they were barely teenagers......**I know just how dangerous it is for an influential organization like the NCAA to glorify medically transitioning children.** As a woman, I understand how unsafe it can be to force girls to share a locker room and other vulnerable spaces with men.And as a conservative, I recognize that it’s a violation of our constitutional freedoms for the “transgender” movement to ignore obvious distinctions between men and women —erasing equal opportunities that real women fought so hard to achieve and pass to future generations of women. **[This is why I’m urgently asking you to add your name to the BAN MEN FROM WOMEN’S SPORTS Petition right away.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/E-J1Qwj1KWH410r1B-qCcQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoGzKkP0SUaHR0cHM6Ly9hbmVkb3QubGliZXJ0eWNlbnRlci5vcmcvNjQwZGQzMTgtNTNlYy00Njk3LThhZTUtZTNjY2E4MjQ0OGEwP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9QkRHLVJFTiZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPUVNJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI0MDUwNl9CREdfQ0ZBTF9OQ0FBX1JFTl9QQS1DQlcDc3BjQgpmM_OYOGbA20HlUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** My name is Harmeet Dhillon and I’m the CEO and Founder of the **_Center for American Liberty_** – a conservative not-for-profit law firm that is leading the charge against the woke transgender agenda.
---
* We’re suing Kaiser Permanente and the child mutilators who medically transitioned Chloe Cole to a “boy” when she was just 13 years old. **_Chloe did not give informed consent and now faces a lifetime of serious medical issues because of the drugs, hormones, and surgeries forced on her._**
* We just sent a demand letter on behalf of a grandmother who was banned for life from her local YMCA because she confronted a man in the ladies’ locker room – who was wearing a women’s bathing suit and watching two little girls undress. **_The YMCA called the police on Julie, demonized her in the community, and banished her from the pool she frequented for 40 years._**
* And we’re headed to the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals for a major hearing in the case of a California mother whose daughter was secretly transitioned to a “boy” at school. The fifth-grade child was given a new name, new pronouns, and new bathroom—all without so much as a phone call to mom for her permission. **_This radical school district robbed her mother, Aurora Regino, of her God-given parental rights to raise her child the way she sees fit._**

---
| | I won’t mince words... Robbing women of equal opportunities in college athletics AND forcing them to share locker rooms and showers with males is unacceptable. But that’s exactly what the NCAA is doing.It’s an attack on the God-given rights and constitutional freedoms of every American.And it’s up to you and me to stop it. Right here, right now. **[That’s why after signing the BAN MEN FROM WOMEN’S SPORTS Petition, I ask that you make a tax-deductible donation of $25 to the _Center for American Liberty._](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/E-J1Qwj1KWH410r1B-qCcQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoGzKkP0SUaHR0cHM6Ly9hbmVkb3QubGliZXJ0eWNlbnRlci5vcmcvNjQwZGQzMTgtNTNlYy00Njk3LThhZTUtZTNjY2E4MjQ0OGEwP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9QkRHLVJFTiZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPUVNJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI0MDUwNl9CREdfQ0ZBTF9OQ0FBX1JFTl9QQS1DQlcDc3BjQgpmM_OYOGbA20HlUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** Your generous support will ensure we have the resources to win our groundbreaking litigation on behalf of Chloe, Julie, Aurora, and many others.More importantly, your signature on this vital petition will send a clear message – not just to the leaders in college athletics but to every radical leading a school district, hospital, or athletic facility in America – that you won’t tolerate this lunacy a moment longer.**[So please follow this link to sign the BAN MEN FROM WOMEN’S SPORTS Petition and make your best tax-deductible donation right away.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/E-J1Qwj1KWH410r1B-qCcQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoGzKkP0SUaHR0cHM6Ly9hbmVkb3QubGliZXJ0eWNlbnRlci5vcmcvNjQwZGQzMTgtNTNlYy00Njk3LThhZTUtZTNjY2E4MjQ0OGEwP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9QkRHLVJFTiZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPUVNJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI0MDUwNl9CREdfQ0ZBTF9OQ0FBX1JFTl9QQS1DQlcDc3BjQgpmM_OYOGbA20HlUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** If the NAIA can protect women’s sports, so can the NCAA.

Let’s build off this momentum. Thank you in advance for your support.

## Hamas Bombs Aid Crossing, Ends Negotiation
Hamas killed three Israeli soldiers Sunday in an attack on [a crossing into Gaza ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGSrCAQheGnwawtRBANDG5iNjfd0Gqh1d5FmQJmrNmn35qNNz0n-er_uM035MDn9h8PGssaZ3SFnzQb6EDpWVd-XIkUtRWNjW30MPR2aKp9NENDHlu7YivNYrFVvaSevKPVGdNRxaOSSksjO9mbrrW1VsOiCHs7WKf7vhFakucSU_0Z-Sw7reEVn5RqF48qjHsp9yzaf0JNQk3XddWJHoVSfv_vJabghZoO9j4QEOYi1LTjgRlcQD4yJMr3eGZeOHB5AZaC7gs4J6QAG34jLDF5SuBSzJnPDRzmB4bClOGtB2lAGqGmKo3-fnEInDsrtNwO5PALLX9V-wkAAP__Xl5wOw)used by trucks delivering humanitarian aid. The crossing is now shut down. At the same time, Hamas announced it was [ending ceasefire negotiations](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAUAL_G3ogAg4GBoUu2dO1oPcwjfhXGFtBE7ddX6dzxdMvpPm7LDShTub_Djr6nY4G10wMXzWYm1aLG6BOixGlEL4xQzlnjxLh5EIAhyAmEiTymhKvSUgA6LiauLB_JSy4V13zmVs-TuSjpgkSwxplVWSsGxTFSP-rl86DSN0z5-3hgvazHPma_9X62YXob5HWQVzgLPttLvaB2WjMO8kqtAmZ2QsbWqRCUxu7wA2yDHRp7QmXb1w6FOlSCwoAi0ylwpXWwYjYqyJBwstE5szod58T5WH08n5QztdkMit93oPwX1f879BsAAP__3PVm6w) in Cairo after Israel rejected its demands to end the war. Israeli officials warned of a substantial military operation in the "very near future" into Rafah, Hamas' last major stronghold in Gaza. Israel also raided a Jerusalem hotel room used by Al Jazeera after the government decided to [shut down the Qatari-owned media outlet's](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O8yAQAJ8GOiLA_CwFxdeky9deaS1miYlwHGGU6PL0p1x95Wia0Xxd5gvWVu_X_7hRHGWfcRn1SbMVTmgzG55jIdI0cYrKKxMC-KD4GovOmYp0MJXsrU2oIBhPkADQJT_xGrXURlrpJFg3-ZPRIWlC8MEvBkAxIynXsffTba_3sVJp3_uT-mnZN97iOsbjYNM_ps9Mn_Fxp9fxUR_ooy6NmD7XoyM1ge2Gb6KOYsUND3HFN4oXdkEJg1EOCUEXKy2mIIHIyawyWTK8x_x41dbq4Twz8rphbb8B468bPwEAAP__uNBfug) local operations in Israel. The Israelis said the network would remain closed until the war in Gaza ended.
## Heavy Rains Flood Houston, East Texas
Hundreds of people were rescued from floodwaters in Houston as heavy rain swamped a wide region from the city to rural East Texas. [Photos and video are here.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL_G3hzBGd_BwNAlW7p2tDCc46sIRDZN2r-v0rnj0xue9D4u8yVIlnJ9Dzf2ba1ziE0ePE8DDmBm0ye_MgOPPXtN2jhnyel-80iojMWETrFKiwbAiWxEGBMvCbEXDwqMmhQqO-FIJwNuAQ6WHEVjre6M4iSt7qfPKqVtvOaf-uD9FOutz35r7X5041sH5w7O4V74ebzUC_YmMXMH5zXXmqRch8bf4Ri2-nW0WoY9SBnIjata4uJsdBwtpaAIaNLEtGqy1O8-3Z-SsxxInVHXW5D8F2__nfgNAAD__2S_XSw) Game wardens rode airboats [through waist-high water](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuhSAYRp8GN4wiCgwMXdxu147mR36UBuEG6KV9-8bO3b7ky8lJzsdje4APPh7vcKGuLm2wV__CbaYLZXzjndUOkeHUoR7FyJWSQo3dqc3o7LTbeeZOoJGgJrkYkEaBsQYU67xmA-PDPCyDnJdJ9JwpwxCkUGLnUo6ED2h9Tbn_TD7WE134SS_M_Z6uLuiz1mch0xthK2Fra63fTYnYyv0Ttt6TsPVMX6WmSCt-Q6GlpnwV6kJK1seDNoR6YqYNcvTxuIEua_tsPgRfFkH4cFzgw5-z_hfgNwAA__81517t) to save people and pets, while in Houston crews were plucking people off the rooftops of flooded homes. About 11 million people in Texas and Oklahoma are under flood warnings this weekend. Between 12 to 20 inches of rain have fallen in the area in the past week, forcing evacuations. | Peter Willis, Believe it or not, my opponent, a politician who served 22-years in elected office, screwed up his petitions to get on the ballot for the 2024 congressional race.Michigan requires every candidate for the U.S. House of Representatives to submit 1,000 signatures of valid registered voters from their district. There is a specific petition format and the State requires strict compliance for those signatures to be eligible.One of those requirements is the title of the office sought. My opponent put “U.S. Congress,” which is not an office, nor a title, it is a branch of government that includes the Senate _and_ the House of Representatives. The State requires candidates to use “Representative to Congress,” which I did.

[**Top Trump ally Roger Stone endorses James Judge in Florida’s 15th Congressional District**](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=1c952f15df&e=00028e5542)
_The top Trump ally and confidante is supporting James Judge after Judge answered President Trump’s call to challenge RINO Rep. Laurel Lee (R-FL)._

TAMPA, Fla. – One of President Donald Trump’s top allies endorsed James Judge on Monday in the Republican primary for Florida’s 15th Congressional District.
Roger Stone, a longtime friend, ally and confidante of Trump whose reputation as a political operator precedes him, says Republican primary voters in FL-15 should vote for James Judge on Aug. 20.
“I’ve known James for a couple of years now, and I know he’s on board with the MAGA agenda, which is what we need out of our Republican Congressmen and women,” said Stone. “Laurel Lee has been disloyal to President Trump and backed Ron DeSantis in his loser campaign for president. Now she says she supports Trump, but the fact is she’ll say whatever is politically convenient. James is a Trump supporter through and through, and I trust that he’ll work with the President to drain the Washington swamp and support the 47 Agenda.”
Judge, a Christian, conservative Coast Guard veteran and small business owner, thanked Stone for the endorsement.
“Roger is a once-in-a-generation legend in the world of Republican politics,” said Judge. “I’m proud to call him a friend, and I’m grateful for his endorsement in my race against Laurel Lee, who not only betrayed President Trump and the MAGA agenda, but more importantly betrayed her constituents in this district, who overwhelmingly support President Trump. She wants to pretend to be on President Trump’s side now, but the damage is already done.”
In Late March, Trump called for a challenger to step up and run against Lee. Judge answered that call.
According to FEC reports, Lee has taken hundreds of special interest contributions, a number of which are from enemies of Trump, the MAGA agenda and the political right, including Facebook and Google. Lee is also an ally of disgraced former House Speaker Kevin McCarthy.
“In her first term in Congress, Laurel Lee has already sold out to special interests,” said Judge. “She also just rolled over to Democrats and voted to give billions of taxpayer dollars that we don’t have to foreign countries as part of a bill that doesn’t even close the wide open southern border. We cannot keep electing Republicans like this and expect different results.”
About James Judge:James Judge, a Florida native, graduated from Eckerd College in St. Petersburg and served in the U.S. Coast Guard in Operation Iraqi Freedom. Additionally, he served in Kabul, Afghanistan as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2010 until 2011. He now owns Judge Public Relations, a Tampa-based public relations, marketing and consulting firm. Judge is married to his wife Danielle, who is also a small business owner. The Judges live on a ranch in Dade City, with their five dogs, three cats, chickens, cows, goats and horses. Judge is a proud member of the NRA, Veterans of Foreign Wars and the American Legion. The Judges are also longtime, active members at Idlewild Baptist Church in Lutz.
_“Without God, there could be no American form of Government, nor an American way of life. Recognition of the Supreme Being is the first–the most basic–expression of Americanism. Thus the Founding Fathers saw it, and thus, with God’s help, it will continue to be.”_ – Dwight D. Eisenhower

body:

Dear Peter,
The highly anticipated 25th Annual Massachusetts Democratic Party Dinner featuring the Roosevelt Awards is just around the corner, and we want you to be a part [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/roo25?am=20&contactdata=LkPTGIPE1xB4Q7hy/oJsVWNmzZLyqbCh2jALNLE0ZK86YtZr0EoQ3LudZv/luDcOQ0C45lts62Irae5QDdntiqVJ1FpTw1dFwUbsDjCpbfIUv6dB7S/uTr8WOR9at4ntxuRegm/qKyMd26g/4dqp9OJU+sSc4p51GfJqSZrk/jw=] of this extraordinary evening. Please mark your calendar for Thursday, June 13th, from 6:00 - 8:00 PM at the Fairmont Copley Plaza Hotel (138 St. James Avenue, Boston, MA).
This year, we are thrilled to pay tribute to two remarkable individuals and their unwavering dedication to our Democratic community with the President Franklin and Eleanor Roosevelt Awards. Join us as we honor The Honorable Former Speaker Bob DeLeo for his outstanding service, leadership, and commitment to advancing democratic principles and Democratic Activist Linda Whitlock for her tireless advocacy and dedication to championing democratic values and causes.
From our awardees;
"My family’s century-long history of political engagement has been the inspiration for my own participation in civic life and electoral politics. From an early age, I learned that every American has an obligation to try to make our communities better for ALL of us. As a proud Democrat, I am humbled to receive this year’s Roosevelt Award alongside former Speaker of the Massachusetts House of Representatives Robert DeLeo, a transformative political leader. What a celebration we will have on June 13th!" -Linda Whitlock
"It is my honor to be the recipient of this award named for two of my political heroes,” said Robert A. DeLeo, who led the Massachusetts House of Representatives as Speaker from 2009 to 2020. “As Speaker I strove to follow the legacy of Franklin and Eleanor Roosevelt in ensuring the safety and civil rights of our residents, providing for those most in need of help, and constructing a secure economic future; by introducing and passing ground-breaking gun safety legislation, protections for transgender individual and reproductive rights, historic support for Early Education Care, and benefits of families with a member with autism, I believe the members of the House and I did our best to do that. I’m grateful to receive this award alongside an iconic leader like Linda Whitlock.” -Speaker DeLeo
We are also excited to announce the recipient of our Activist Award, established last year in honor of Chris Condon's legacy. This year, MassDems will be honoring Reproductive Equity Now President Becca Hart Holder and Reproductive Freedom Activists everywhere for their tireless work in the years post-Dobbs to ensure that all people have the right to choose what to do with their own body.
Don't miss this opportunity to be part of our 25th Annual Massachusetts Democratic Party Dinner featuring the Roosevelt Awards! Secure your sponsorships and tickets here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/roo25] to ensure your attendance at this unforgettable celebration.
I look forward to celebrating with you as we honor these exceptional individuals and their remarkable achievements in the Massachusetts Democratic Party.
Warm regards,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Steve%20K%27s%20Signature.png]
Steve Kerrigan

| Dear Peter,
[Time's Up TikTok](https://tijrkiebb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ZLkimGVwP0xNvTuYVO-aGAXo8TWiDBe0RnZyNd_WeqfjSomrUkNGKQHVA_JO-GynYZ5rLxV1IAKwcRrFGsGClue9Wl7rVPMtuzmP0dGhDYNwj2s6a2oobzvN30qeNsBgdozzc83X1J7Gh3MG3chPvdcCjcHeb4R9&c=Swp_xeXz4t7Zp9AHmX2vmjZ7QYRPrqYWEosVANZNsrfR2eNBd4RFVQ==&ch=I0QDJ4ARGss0sa-xH-8hsrS4fdwTv1MxkFe_DQK5qVu1rzmnojoN3w==) was proud to play a role in helping pass the TikTok ban that was signed by President Joe Biden into law on April 24th.
But the fight is not over. The fight over TikTok brought to bear the most clear example we have seen of the Chinese Communist Party working to buy influence through powerful lobbying firms. In fact, there were numerous reports that the Chinese Embassy sent diplomats to meet with Congressional offices during the weeks leading up to the vote.
This is why I encourage everyone to read the [2024 Annual United States Commission on International Religious Freedom](https://tijrkiebb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ZLkimGVwP0xNvTuYVO-aGAXo8TWiDBe0RnZyNd_WeqfjSomrUkNGKcIMOpdIXB7np57cnFQq4QPNWnayunLI5CLUp_cQo54n6f2t2F6wJyzAaF08SCcuLnIAvHAsC344CTK2kpvYZvUa2P7ScVJka8PMMkbEGIjawuag0aACs8YI_O5QMg2d6vkEhnRmc7a4kcQDI0uIkzO8ZFDI8ioVRNGVc-0uc-djBYxvKGf2Ty0=&c=Swp_xeXz4t7Zp9AHmX2vmjZ7QYRPrqYWEosVANZNsrfR2eNBd4RFVQ==&ch=I0QDJ4ARGss0sa-xH-8hsrS4fdwTv1MxkFe_DQK5qVu1rzmnojoN3w==), specifically after the China section where ALL NINE commissioners in bipartisan fashion call to ban lobbying for the Communist Chinese Government.
They stated, "It is imperative to ban lobbying for the Chinese government, its state-affiliated commercial entities, and their interests while the government continues its egregious acts of religious persecution. These harsh actions impact every faith group in China with leaders of the Catholic Church and Protestant house churches imprisoned and even "disappeared."
Communist China is committing cultural genocide as it devastates Tibet where Buddhist monks die in prison. Their actions of physical genocide ravages Uyghur Muslims, where millions are sent to detention camps and Uyghur children are taken from their parents. Organs are harvested from Falun Gong and Uyghurs, some while still alive, and in Hong Kong, the Chinese government represses freedom loving Christians, including 92-year-old Cardinal Zen. China not only persecutes their own citizens but now it is pushing to spread communist influence worldwide. China supports Iran, which provided training and weapons for the attacks on Israel by Hamas and they supply arms to Hezbollah and the Houthis.
China aids Russia in its war on Ukraine and supports North Korea, one of the world's worst religious persecutors. And they are spreading their influence in the Americas. China supports both Nicaragua and Cuba where Christians are being aggressively persecuted.
Concerns are rising daily over China threatening to attack Taiwan, which many experts believe may lead to direct U.S. involvement and the loss of American military lives.
Amidst all of this, the words of 18th-century British parliamentarian William Wilberforce about the evils of the slave trade come to mind: "You may choose to look the other way, but you can never say again that you do not know."
The U.S. Congress and the American people cannot look the other way. For the good of our country and religious freedom worldwide, we are asking Congress to ban lobbying for the Chinese government and its interests.
Our goals:

* We are encouraging all Human Rights organizations to push for a Communist China lobbying ban when meeting with Congressional offices.

* We are asking individuals, like you, to call their Members of Congress ([Senator](https://tijrkiebb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ZLkimGVwP0xNvTuYVO-aGAXo8TWiDBe0RnZyNd_WeqfjSomrUkNGKcIMOpdIXB7nS8y8nPoioDRMCfSMWEV_HyyKfAXC5B0-laKZkvR95f5FWkyxj04b-Rz0oe64vI5hBu6bTLCKM0c7f5UUpsJXo7JbVVqQugVZ7Uy9_7W2Smf_AaH53H_0bLhd_TbnFkcW&c=Swp_xeXz4t7Zp9AHmX2vmjZ7QYRPrqYWEosVANZNsrfR2eNBd4RFVQ==&ch=I0QDJ4ARGss0sa-xH-8hsrS4fdwTv1MxkFe_DQK5qVu1rzmnojoN3w==) and [House Representative](https://tijrkiebb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ZLkimGVwP0xNvTuYVO-aGAXo8TWiDBe0RnZyNd_WeqfjSomrUkNGKcIMOpdIXB7nwP0r5duDB2TpFlPtgCnWrf6opnmZgrq-TdPXklXZmDlNPGtY2SN3UYPpUYiAsaxqUItPRgp7dRi42N5pdPge7fEcUs5zbU3o9LCXKkQuDi17fLVKqnBYa0-GXlw8SjKp_igAnK6_C9A=&c=Swp_xeXz4t7Zp9AHmX2vmjZ7QYRPrqYWEosVANZNsrfR2eNBd4RFVQ==&ch=I0QDJ4ARGss0sa-xH-8hsrS4fdwTv1MxkFe_DQK5qVu1rzmnojoN3w==)) to support a ban on lobbying for China.

* And we are raising funds to increase the pressure and spread the word about China's human rights abuse and our need to ban Communist China's lobbying in Washington.

Please follow this link [HERE](https://tijrkiebb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ZLkimGVwP0xNvTuYVO-aGAXo8TWiDBe0RnZyNd_WeqfjSomrUkNGKQHVA_JO-GynFqdlSa6y-LKdjDEvnwMGVI10UTUZgDnwHtAU61XUxSLqPvhoQ-8DKCYV7xUHJEOEYoqRmK0RyFJApHBXAKaPehQ5rv52Ua2a9EEi8-PAiNqaXklk-avFvT_ye4KRTk7nuwdp0wydTybOlHhWIbOocGt3phFMmFrg&c=Swp_xeXz4t7Zp9AHmX2vmjZ7QYRPrqYWEosVANZNsrfR2eNBd4RFVQ==&ch=I0QDJ4ARGss0sa-xH-8hsrS4fdwTv1MxkFe_DQK5qVu1rzmnojoN3w==) to support our efforts to warn Congress and the World of the dangers presented by Communist China.

Listen, Rick Scott is a bully, plain and simple. **But I'm no stranger to bullies like him — and he doesn't scare me.** Will you let me explain?

[(If you're ready to stand up to this bully right now, you can chip in a donation here to help me defeat Rick Scott.)](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84408672/471419853/849749119?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1193-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWJhNzczYzktYWMwYi1lZjExLTk2ZjMtN2MxZTUyMWIwN2Y5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=3GxDKhSrg273J5ptxlO5xVUKnVRS--dGF-16zop5y1o=)
Moving to America from Ecuador wasn't easy for a 14-year-old girl. Even though I spoke English, my classmates would mock my accent. I struggled to make friends. It was one of the hardest times of my life. **But I was lucky. I had the best secret weapon a girl could dream of:_older sisters._**
My three older sisters were bold, confident, and proud. I grew up admiring and _adoring_ them. **They taught me how to stand up for myself, how to demand better, and how to handle a mean schoolyard bully.** My sisters were never afraid to go to bat for me — and they taught me not to be afraid, no matter how mean the bully.
One year, I got into an AP English Literature class. I was thrilled. But my teacher _refused_ to call on me — even when I was the only one raising my hand. She made it clear that, because I had an accent, because I was an immigrant, she felt that I shouldn't be in her classroom. She had an idea of the perfect student, and I just didn't fit it. So one day, my sister marched right into the classroom and gave that teacher a piece of her mind. She sat her down and told her point-blank, you _cannot_ discriminate against my sister.
Unfortunately, that conversation didn't change my teacher's mind — or her actions. But knowing that my sisters would always have my back inspired me to stand up for myself, too. **I refused to let the bullies stop me from being myself and speaking my mind. Eventually, I even ran for student government and became student body secretary.**
Now, I'm running for U.S. Senate. And my opponent is using the same tactics as the bullies I faced all those years ago. He's spreading lies and dirty rumors. He's pushing a hateful agenda that tears our communities apart. He's even throwing temper tantrums to the press. He doesn't care about Florida or our communities. _He just cares about himself._
**This campaign is about standing up to Rick Scott and his extremist agenda. It's about inspiring voters to demand better and say enough is enough.**_**Ya no más.**_**I'll never let Rick Scott silence me or intimidate me. But my sisters taught me the power of standing together — and I need your help to win.**[Please, will you rush $5 before midnight tonight to help my campaign defeat Rick Scott and win a better future for all of us?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84408673/471419854/849749119?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk1193-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWJhNzczYzktYWMwYi1lZjExLTk2ZjMtN2MxZTUyMWIwN2Y5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=3GxDKhSrg273J5ptxlO5xVUKnVRS--dGF-16zop5y1o=)

| | **Dear Sponsors of the National Fallen Officer Foundation,**

On behalf of the National Fallen Officer Foundation (NFOF), I would like to express our deepest gratitude for your continued support of police officers across our nation. Your generosity allows the NFOF to have a tremendous impact on the lives of these brave men and women, as well as their families, during some of their most challenging moments.

The dedication of police officers is unwavering. They serve and protect our communities under all circumstances, including the most dangerous of social and environmental conditions. This commitment is all the more remarkable when we consider the significant risks they face every day.

Tragically, in 2024 alone, there have already been **55** line-of-duty deaths of police officers in the USA. **Twenty (20) of those deaths occurred by gunfire**. This figure includes the tragic death of the 4 law enforcement professionals in east Charlotte, North Carolina on April 29th.

The National Fallen Officer Foundation has been at the forefront of supporting these families during this incredibly difficult time. We offer financial assistance, counseling, and educational resources to help them navigate through their grief and rebuild their lives.

Being a police professional is not just a career decision, **it’s a life decision**. Far too often police professionals pay the ultimate sacrifice to withhold the “thin blue line” that separates our civil society from mayhem and anarchy.

Below are some of the fallen heroes whose families we will be supporting. These heroes have made the ultimate sacrifice while serving on the _thin blue line_ :

clean_body: | | | | | | | Dear Sponsors of the National Fallen Officer Foundation, On behalf of the National Fallen Officer Foundation (NFOF), I would like to express our deepest gratitude for your continued support of police officers across our nation. Your generosity allows the NFOF to have a tremendous impact on the lives of these brave men and women, as well as their families, during some of their most challenging moments. The dedication of police officers is unwavering. They serve and protect our communities under all circumstances, including the most dangerous of social and environmental conditions. This commitment is all the more remarkable when we consider the significant risks they face every day. Tragically, in 2024 alone, there have already been 55 line-of-duty deaths of police officers in the USA. Twenty (20) of those deaths occurred by gunfire. This figure includes the tragic death of the 4 law enforcement professionals in east Charlotte, North Carolina on April 29th. The National Fallen Officer Foundation has been at the forefront of supporting these families during this incredibly difficult time. We offer financial assistance, counseling, and educational resources to help them navigate through their grief and rebuild their lives. Being a police professional is not just a career decision, it’s a life decision. Far too often police professionals pay the ultimate sacrifice to withhold the “thin blue line” that separates our civil society from mayhem and anarchy. subject: A more personal message

| | | | Team —This is a more personal message than you generally receive from a campaign, but I wanted to pull back the curtain a bit why I’m in this race, and what the result will mean for our country.The last few years have been grueling for our nation and our democracy, but it hasn’t always been like this.There was a time before Donald Trump. When you could disagree without being disagreeable. When it wasn’t taboo to have friends across the aisle, or at least people you could work with. When you would bring people together — Democrats and Republicans — to get things done.Why? Because it was in the best interest of the American people to have a government that functioned. And that wasn’t in chaos 24/7.Those days feel long gone now. We have seen a seismic shift in the last few years — since a charlatan celebrity and reality TV host who called disabled veterans “suckers” and “losers,” denigrated our immigrant communities, and railed on about “fake news” was elected President of the United States.I’ve never been one to back down from the bad guys — so amidst these attacks, I did my duty and called him out. I took on these fights not because they were easy, but because it needed to be done.That vitriol has taken a turn for the worse. Here’s what the other side has had to say about me:“Wild-eyed conspiracy nut.” - Tucker Carlson“Pencil neck. Shifty Schiff.” - Donald Trump“[He] openly lied to the American public.” - Kevin McCarthyNever in my life would I expect to be cast a president’s “favorite” enemy — but here we are. And I’m not going to back down.It doesn’t end with these personal attacks either. With every new insult comes a horde of MAGA supporters, ready to pile on more death threats. Through Twitter. Email. Phone calls. Letters. You name it. With multiple people prosecuted for threatening to kill me. That NEVER happened before Trump.There are days when the fight gets difficult. During the impeachment process. Serving on the January 6 Committee. When House Republicans censured me for doing my constitutional duty.But like I said on the House floor, I am honored by their enmity. I am flattered by the falsehoods they level against me. Those who were the authors of the big lie must attack the truth tellers and I am proud to stand accused. I wear their attacks as a badge of honor. Knowing that I have lived by my oath of office.My guiding principle has been serving in a way that will bring pride to my children. I believe that right and truth and decency matter now more than ever.After long nights of consideration, I decided to run for California’s U.S. Senate seat. Because MAGA Republicans aren’t getting the job done and there’s too much that needs fixing. I have a record of getting tough things done, and I’m ready to do the hard work needed for our families, for our economy, for our democracy, and for our planet.[**It’s clear Donald Trump and MAGA Republicans are going to do everything they can to sabotage my campaign — because they know how effective I am at gathering the truth, making a case, and holding them accountable. I need your help to overcome their attacks. Will you rush in a split $10 donation between No Dem Left Behind and my campaign to help me continue my work for the American people?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ndlb_ca_split?refcode=personal&amount=10)

name: Kevin Sorbo
subject: Hero Worship in The Fountainhead
body:
You probably didn’t expect this email from me.

*|MC_PREVIEW_TEXT|* |
---
| | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8enocksam8q411hjeee95srchrelvbml0797u1o_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c1h68p32c9h2bs) Friend,

You probably didn’t expect this email from me. It’s not about a new film or a political beef... but something deeper: philosophy and literature.

Like many of you, my wife Sam and I were deeply inspired by the novels of Ayn Rand, _The Fountainhead_ , and _Atlas Shrugged_. Sam identified with the character of Dagny Taggart fending off “moochers and looters,” while I connected with Howard Roark’s pursuit of artistic integrity.

It wasn’t until recently that I began to think of another one of Rand’s prophetic themes: her celebration of the masculine ideal — of strength, independence, and decisiveness as masculine virtues.

Yet today, masculinity is under attack — and has been for decades. No wonder so many boys and young men are feeling alienated, confused, and anxious.

First, we’re the butt of sitcom jokes. Eventually, the most masculine of us were considered “the bad guys.” Now, it seems like any form of masculinity is the "toxic" type.

>From the time these young men start attending school, they are lectured about their “male privilege” and inculcated with guilt as “oppressors,” even as they’re being marginalized and silenced themselves. What’s more, boys and girls alike are bombarded with messages in school and especially on social media about so-called “gender fluidity,” an ideological assault not just on masculinity and femininity but on the very concept of Objective Reality itself!

If young people could discover the literature of Ayn Rand — and her distinctly masculine heroes like John Galt and Howard Roark — perhaps they’d be inspired, as I was, to embrace masculinity and heroism and cultivate the personal virtues of reason, integrity, independence, and pride in achievement.

But here’s the rub: in the 1970s, 70% of young people were reading books every day for fun. Today, that percentage has plummeted to just 12%. How, then, to inspire young people to commit to reading a 1,000+ page novel?!

That’s where The Atlas Society comes in. Sam and I were introduced to the work of The Atlas Society by its CEO, Jennifer Grossman (JAG). We became friends with JAG when Sam and I lived in Southern California — I met her when I had to rescue her from a flat tire (talk about masculine virtue!). Joking aside, we were brought together by our shared admiration for the literature of Ayn Rand — and since then, have been actively involved with the organization: _with Sam emceeing their annual gala, appearing on panels, and joining in their weekly podcasts_.

What struck us about the approach of The Atlas Society was how they leverage art and technology to engage young people with Rand’s ideas — adapting her novels and screenplays into graphic novels, producing viral animated videos, hosting rollicking student conferences — that make philosophy fun and accessible.

**[I told Jennifer Anju Grossman (JAG), the CEO of The Atlas Society, that I would help them raise $30,000 this month. You can help them inspire young people to embrace their heroic nature by donating $10, $20, $50, or even $100 today.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zh5p0r15lpm57l9jesiekptr9rr5ttqpuge9ue60_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c1h68p32c9h2bs)**
[Donate](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z12ua8c9ft6mcmt8pj2oe2eiffcmg3011hdg7b60_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c1h68p32c9h2bs)
But I’ll tell you another reason Sam and I warmed to the work of The Atlas Society. It was an op-ed JAG published in The Wall Street Journal: “Can You Love God and Ayn Rand? As deeply devout Christians, we love Rand’s fierce defense of individualism and capitalism — but we part ways on the issue of faith. And for that reason, we appreciated the warm, and non-dogmatic attitude of The Atlas Society — welcoming religious and non-religious Ayn Rand fans alike.
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z09dni90t29lucdg3oe5i0m9n5imhv1205s5bchg_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c1h68p32c9h2bs)
The Atlas Society’s programs have reached MILLIONS of young people through their events, graphic novels, and online content! clean_body: You probably didn’t expect this email from me. |MCPREVIEWTEXT| | | | Friend, You probably didn’t expect this email from me. It’s not about a new film or a political beef... but something deeper: philosophy and literature. Like many of you, my wife Sam and I were deeply inspired by the novels of Ayn Rand, The Fountainhead , and Atlas Shrugged. Sam identified with the character of Dagny Taggart fending off “moochers and looters,” while I connected with Howard Roark’s pursuit of artistic integrity. It wasn’t until recently that I began to think of another one of Rand’s prophetic themes: her celebration of the masculine ideal — of strength, independence, and decisiveness as masculine virtues. Yet today, masculinity is under attack — and has been for decades. No wonder so many boys and young men are feeling alienated, confused, and anxious. First, we’re the butt of sitcom jokes. Eventually, the most masculine of us were considered “the bad guys.” Now, it seems like any form of masculinity is the "toxic" type. From the time these young men start attending school, they are lectured about their “male privilege” and inculcated with guilt as “oppressors,” even as they’re being marginalized and silenced themselves. What’s more, boys and girls alike are bombarded with messages in school and especially on social media about so-called “gender fluidity,” an ideological assault not just on masculinity and femininity but on the very concept of Objective Reality itself! If young people could discover the literature of Ayn Rand — and her distinctly masculine heroes like John Galt and Howard Roark — perhaps they’d be inspired, as I was, to embrace masculinity and heroism and cultivate the personal virtues of reason, integrity, independence, and pride in achievement. But here’s the rub: in the 1970s, 70% of young people were reading books every day for fun. Today, that percentage has plummeted to just 12%. How, then, to inspire young people to commit to reading a 1,000+ page novel?! That’s where The Atlas Society comes in. Sam and I were introduced to the work of The Atlas Society by its CEO, Jennifer Grossman (JAG). We became friends with JAG when Sam and I lived in Southern California — I met her when I had to rescue her from a flat tire (talk about masculine virtue!). Joking aside, we were brought together by our shared admiration for the literature of Ayn Rand — and since then, have been actively involved with the organization: with Sam emceeing their annual gala, appearing on panels, and joining in their weekly podcasts. What struck us about the approach of The Atlas Society was how they leverage art and technology to engage young people with Rand’s ideas — adapting her novels and screenplays into graphic novels, producing viral animated videos, hosting rollicking student conferences — that make philosophy fun and accessible. But I’ll tell you another reason Sam and I warmed to the work of The Atlas Society. It was an op-ed JAG published in The Wall Street Journal: “Can You Love God and Ayn Rand? As deeply devout Christians, we love Rand’s fierce defense of individualism and capitalism — but we part ways on the issue of faith. And for that reason, we appreciated the warm, and non-dogmatic attitude of The Atlas Society — welcoming religious and non-religious Ayn Rand fans alike. The Atlas Society’s programs have reached MILLIONS of young people through their events, graphic novels, and online content! Your generous donation will help them reach even more of the next generation with the virtues of reason, individualism, and achievement. Click any button to show your support. The literature of Ayn Rand can help young people not only discover a new respect for men and masculine values — but for MAN as a heroic being, with reason as his only absolute and productive achievement as his noblest activity. You can inspire the next generation to embrace their heroic nature by helping me raise $30,000 for The Atlas Society this month. Today, as a U.S. Senator for Ohio, I honor Mamaw's legacy by fighting for hardworking families and ensuring opportunities for all Ohioans. I've dedicated myself to rebuilding our communities. Now, | The opposition hopes we'll lose faith – in ourselves and in the future of our region. But I refuse to give up, and I know you won't either. Our shared heritage and the unique fabric of our American spirit are worth preserving. I understand if some may overlook this message. But for those who recognize the urgency of our cause, your support is invaluable. If you believe, as I do, that it's time to reclaim our voice and rebuild our communities, Thank you for standing shoulder-to-shoulder with me in this fight. Sincerely, JD Vance Conservative Outsider. Marine. Businessman. Author. Ohio needs a true conservative in the U.S. Senate. body:

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWnmSMRiNd

Friend,

If we're
going to witness the REVIVAL we've been praying for in America,
the church needs to MOBILIZE.

We need
strong followers of Jesus to rise up, point their fingers at the
sin of America, and say, "Let's turn it around!"

That's
why I'm thrilled to announce TPUSA Faith's FIRST-OF-ITS-KIND
Believers Summit, which I hope and pray will reignite a revival
of COURAGE-FILLED CHRISTIANS across America.

Will you
help engage THOUSANDS of young believers through TPUSA Faith's
Believers Summit and equip them to stand strong in their faith
against "Woke" culture?

Your
generous gift of $25 will help provide ONE student scholarship
... your generous gift of $50 will help provide TWO student
scholarships ... and so on to make it possible for the next
generation to attend this LIFE-CHANGING event.

Help
give a student scholarship to the Believers Summit

With the
help of generous supporters like you, TPUSA Faith empowers the
next generation with practical knowledge and strategies to live
out their faith boldly -- and to counteract the prevailing "Woke"
narratives with grace, truth, and conviction rooted in the
Gospel.

At
twice-yearly TPUSA Faith Pastors Summits, inspiring leaders like
Dave Ramsey, Pastor Jentezen Franklin, Eric Metaxas, Pastor Rob
McCoy, David Barton, Frank Turek, and MORE inspired and equipped
4,000+ pastors...

...and
now we're called to inspire and equip MORE BELIEVERS, especially
young Christians who are most attacked, challenged, and confused
by today's toxic "Woke" culture.

Will you
help engage THOUSANDS of young believers through TPUSA Faith's
Believers Summit and equip them to stand strong in their faith
against "Woke" culture?

Your
generous gift of $25 will help provide ONE student scholarship
... your generous gift of $50 will help provide TWO student
scholarships ... and so on to make it possible for the next
generation to attend this LIFE-CHANGING event!

Help
give a student scholarship to the Believers Summit

TPUSA
Faith has reached thousands of BELIEVERS across America through
our exciting events ... through outreach to our church and pastor
networks ... and through our biblical citizenship classes and
trainings, offered both in-person and online.

And I
know that there are THOUSANDS of Christian students who want to
attend TPUSA Faith's Believers Summit, but they're counting on
generous supporters like YOU to consider supporting of our
student scholarships.

Please
make your most generous gift of $25 to help provide ONE student
scholarship ... your gift of $50 to help provide TWO student
scholarships .. and so on. Your support today will make the
Believers Summit a success and help us WIN the American Culture
War.

Empower
the Next Generation

Imagine
the impact we could have if every believer left the summit
equipped and empowered to live out their faith boldly.

Together,
we can TURN our NATION towards the Lord and see a REVIVAL sweep
across America.

Please
make your most generous gift today to help us bring more young
Christians to this life-changing event. And as you do, please
also PRAY for God's will to be done through the Believers Summit.

Thank you
for partnering with us, Friend. Your generosity is making a
difference in the lives of countless believers and the future of
our nation.

Charlie
Kirk
Founder
TPUSA
Faith

4940 East
Beverly Road
Phoenix,
Arizona 85044

Hey - my name is Byron Donalds.

As Co-Chair of one of the most important initiatives of the Republican Party, I wanted you to what we're doing right now to lay the groundwork for the biggest GOP landslide in AMERICAN HISTORY!

_**[A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen- so bear with me for a minute:](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zqm2e172e4v3709so9qjeq305r7rpbn418tbmipo_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c1h64p74c9h2bs "A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen – so bear with me for a minute:")**_

As Conservatives, we have the issues on our side. We are the only commonsense Party. **If we get these campaign operations right, the Democrats are in serious trouble come election day.**

_But I have to be honest with you: building this level of infrastructure is very expensive._ We're running ads in costly swing-state markets, printing campaign literature, filling up gas tanks to knock doors, recruiting volunteers, and scaling up our voter contact programs.

And unlike the Democrats, we don't rely on Liberal billionaires and rich celebrities for funding.

body:
But I was ready to fight.
| | |
---
I won’t ever forget it, friend.

Standing on the House floor. Hearing shouts, pounding, breaking glass. Barricading the door and teaching my colleagues how to use their gas masks. Texting my staff, telling them to hide.

I carried a rifle in Iraq; all I had to defend myself on January 6th was a pen. But I was ready to fight.
And after that day, Trump’s loyalists crawled right back to him. Witnessing them reject what they lived through, watching them ignore the testimony of the police officers that defended us that day while they were beaten, bloodied, pepper sprayed, cursed at ... it makes me sick.

Kari Lake thinks the January Sixers are patriots who were “invited in” — she even campaigns with them.

I think anyone who supports those terrorists and traitors shouldn’t be allowed anywhere near the U.S. Senate.

This race in Arizona is just me and her. It’s on us to stop her march to more power and influence. Whoever wins in Arizona is going to determine which party holds the Senate and could even decide whether Trump takes back the White House.

I need you with me, and I need you to take this race seriously.

clean_body: But I was ready to fight. | | | I won’t ever forget it, friend. Standing on the House floor. Hearing shouts, pounding, breaking glass. Barricading the door and teaching my colleagues how to use their gas masks. Texting my staff, telling them to hide. I carried a rifle in Iraq; all I had to defend myself on January 6th was a pen. But I was ready to fight. And after that day, Trump’s loyalists crawled right back to him. Witnessing them reject what they lived through, watching them ignore the testimony of the police officers that defended us that day while they were beaten, bloodied, pepper sprayed, cursed at ... it makes me sick. Kari Lake thinks the January Sixers are patriots who were “invited in” — she even campaigns with them. I think anyone who supports those terrorists and traitors shouldn’t be allowed anywhere near the U.S. Senate. This race in Arizona is just me and her. It’s on us to stop her march to more power and influence. Whoever wins in Arizona is going to determine which party holds the Senate and could even decide whether Trump takes back the White House. I need you with me, and I need you to take this race seriously. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Ruben Gallego and Kirsten Gillibrand will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = Thanks for your support. As we gear up for one of the toughest elections of our lives, it means a lot to have you with me. Ruben | * | = A note from Kirsten: Friend, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. As Democrats face our toughest Senate map in decades, I need your help more than ever. While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 — and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority. As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. But I refuse to take a single cent from corporate PACs, which means I’m relying on your grassroots support. = And if you’d like to become a core member of my team and receive exclusive texts from my campaign, = Thank you, Kirsten Gillibrand

name: Eddie Seay
subject: 🔎 Issue spotlight: Paid Family and Medical Leave
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Freedom Virginia, Inc
body:
freedomva.org [freedomva.org]
Friends-
Today we are shining a spotlight on the issue of Paid Family and Medical Leave. Or rather, the lack of access Virginians have to paid leave.
Millions of Virginia workers don’t have the ability to take paid time off for health reasons. Even with unpaid leave under the federal Family and Medical Leave Act, there are Virginians who aren’t able to take time off for their health. Whether that means caring for yourself, a sick loved one, or your newborn child, there is no guarantee that you’ll receive a paycheck when you have to take time off.
Having a Paid Family and Medical Leave program in Virginia is common sense, but the legislation was vetoed this year by Governor Youngkin. This is why we need real people to share their experiences!
Stories have huge impacts on our minds and our emotions. They connect us with others in ways they may not have connected before. They push against our own lived experiences. They open us up to new worlds of solutions and needs we may not be aware of.
Sharing your story is so important. Legislators need to know what is going on in their community and what they can do about it!
If you have experience with the issue of Paid Family and Medical Leave, we’d love to hear from you:
Share your story [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd1corcX24sU8SGyHsLsdf0sOYMn0IUnWer5EUKDjaPTcrszw/viewform?usp=sf_link]
Thank you for your advocacy!
Eddie Seay

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we can communicate directly with you.

body:
Sign our petition. Protect our kids. Demand real reform.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84433406/471485992/-849459103?refcode=ea.05e61eab-ca0b-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ms=ea.05e61eab-ca0b-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNWU2MWVhYi1jYTBiLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=A5DFiWHpvdg0MPM-efwfL__0idj5XU9eVv6Rr8whucM=&emci=4bdb644a-bf0b-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=05e61eab-ca0b-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=46764483)
---
**Uvalde. Sandy Hook. Parkland. Nashville.** These tragic locations represent more than just places on a map — they symbolize the deep scars left by school mass shootings across our nation. Innocent lives, meant to grow and learn in safety, are cut tragically short. **In 2023 alone, the U.S. averaged nearly one school shooting per day.** Tennessee Republicans have a solution: Push legislation to put more guns in schools. Seriously? It's an outrageous response. Lawmakers like Marsha Blackburn who bow to the gun lobby's demands instead of listening to their constituents are failing us. While they cash checks from their donors, our children pay the price in fear and danger. They'll push for arming teachers as if more guns could ever make schools safer. Anything and everything to avoid passing common-sense reform. We've seen the chaos a school shooting wreaks first-hand. More guns mean more risk, not less. name: Jason Call (Jill Stein 2024)
subject: Jill Stein stands with teachers
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=teacher_appreciation_week&n=1)
---
Peter,

Teaching was my first union job and an early lesson in the importance of constant activism and advocacy.

For nearly 20 years I taught mathematics to middle and high school kids of all socio-economic backgrounds.

I was elected by my colleagues to represent them for multiple years on my local Education Association Board, and at our state union assembly.

I have taught in both wealthy and poor neighborhoods. **I have seen disparities in funding even**** _within_****school districts based on zip codes.** In poor communities, many students are faced with limited resources and classroom support – not to mention old, failing infrastructure.

As a lifelong activist herself, Jill knows as well as I do that poverty is the single factor impacting school success. We need a president willing to leverage the power of the federal government to address the root cause of inequality, or that will never change.

**The distribution of poverty hits majority minority schools the hardest.** The response is often punitive, taking away resources rather than adding them. **Worse, the people making decisions about resource distribution are almost never those who really know what students need to succeed –**** _educators!

_** Education is the great equalizer. If we are to truly consider ourselves a democratic society, funding education equitably is imperative. We are far from reaching that goal. Our public schools must be fully funded. _All of them_.

**I’ve been a teacher. I’ve been a union organizer. I’ve been an activist for over 30 years. I have never stopped fighting for a better future – and that’s why I’m proud to be working with Jill to get her elected.

[We urgently need to raise another $100K in the next few days to hire enough petitioners in New York so voters will have a pro-worker, pro-teacher, anti-poverty candidate on the ballot. Can you chip in $25, $50, or even $100 to help us reach our goal?](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=teacher_appreciation_week&n=2)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=teacher_appreciation_week&n=3 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=teacher_appreciation_week&n=3)
---
We have the power to end childhood poverty so that kids aren’t going to school hungry and their families don’t struggle to maintain stable housing – like my students did.

We have the power to fully fund our schools so that teachers aren’t spending their own money on supplies – just like I had to.

As someone who has been on the front lines, who has lived the struggles of working families and who stood up to corrupt corporate influences trying to profit off our kids, Jill Stein has my full faith and confidence as a friend to educators.

Let’s honor our teachers this Teacher Appreciation Week by electing a president who will always have their back.

**[If you believe teachers and their students deserve better than they’ve been getting, will you make a contribution of $25 to this campaign and elect Jill Stein to fight for us?](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=teacher_appreciation_week&n=4)**

In solidarity,

Jason Call
Campaign Manager
Jill Stein 2024

For over half a year, Palestinians have been subjected to non-stop bombings, destruction of schools, and decimation of medical care facilities. Tens of thousands of Palestinians have been murdered, including 15,000 children, and hundreds of thousands displaced. We need peace now. The United States cannot sit by as Israel attacks displaced Palestinians in Rafah with our bombs and our weapons.

**Please call your Congressperson now, we need immediate action! **

subject: you reap what you sow

body:
| Hey folks, hope you’re well.

It’s planting season here in Big Sandy, Montana. [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/67107?t=6&akid=14102%2E878179%2EjYD1B0) Sharla and I have been planting on the same farm for 46 years. Three generations of our family called this land home, and my work here is non-negotiable. It keeps me grounded and I think it makes me a better senator for Montana.

You learn the value of hard work and accountability growing up on the farm. Nothing will get done if you wait around for someone else to do the job. **The key to a successful harvest is hard work during planting season, and friend, we’re running this grassroots campaign the same way.**

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84438551/471499617/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjgwNWZjYTUtZDIwYi1lZjExLTk2ZjMtN2MxZTUyMWIwN2Y5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=wGAm_M-SnCUEjvKaVXz5bCLUdwbaHVbz15rfMI9Pems=&emci=9e08839f-d20b-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=b805fca5-d20b-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=14016711)
Hey Peter,
Earlier this year our Arizona newsroom, _The Copper Courier_ , was the first to break the story about _PragerU_ ’s mission to put right-wing misinformation in Arizona’s public schools.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84438552/471499618/-593472309?refcode=20240506-EM-PragerU&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjgwNWZjYTUtZDIwYi1lZjExLTk2ZjMtN2MxZTUyMWIwN2Y5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=wGAm_M-SnCUEjvKaVXz5bCLUdwbaHVbz15rfMI9Pems=)
_The Copper Courier, January 31, 2024_
We’ll talk more about _PragerU_ and why this matters in a second, but breaking important stories like these takes a tremendous amount of resources. [**If you want to help us continue to inform people in news deserts around the country about the issues in their communities, can you pitch in $15?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84438553/471499619/-593472309?refcode=20240506-EM-PragerU&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjgwNWZjYTUtZDIwYi1lZjExLTk2ZjMtN2MxZTUyMWIwN2Y5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=wGAm_M-SnCUEjvKaVXz5bCLUdwbaHVbz15rfMI9Pems=)
Alright, Peter, if you’ve never heard of the right-wing media company _PragerU_ , buckle up.
_PragerU_ is a right-wing media company that produces short animated videos with titles like “What Radical Islam and the Woke Have in Common" and "Is There Really a Climate Emergency?"
**They even have guest courses from pundits like Tucker Carlson and Candice Owens.**
The group’s CEO has argued that public schools are a “left-wing propaganda machine,” and that _PragerU_ can be the “inoculation” against left-wing misinformation. **This includes an animated Christopher Columbus saying: "Being taken as a slave is better than being killed, no? I don't see the problem."**
Peter, _PragerU_ is leading an aggressive marketing campaign to get in as many public schools as possible. Arizona is the fifth state to allow their videos in classrooms, and they’re looking to expand into as many states as possible.
COURIER can hold these state officials accountable and make sure people know _exactly_ what _PragerU_ is. Parents in these states deserve to know what their kids might be learning in school. That’s why we need to tell these stories.

PragerU is a right-wing media company that produces short animated videos with titles like “What Radical Islam and the Woke Have in Common" and "Is There Really a Climate Emergency?" They even have guest courses from pundits like Tucker Carlson and Candice Owens. The group’s CEO has argued that public schools are a “left-wing propaganda machine,” and that PragerU can be the “inoculation” against left-wing misinformation. This includes an animated Christopher Columbus saying: "Being taken as a slave is better than being killed, no? I don't see the problem." Peter, PragerU is leading an aggressive marketing campaign to get in as many public schools as possible. Arizona is the fifth state to allow their videos in classrooms, and they’re looking to expand into as many states as possible. # Something new: The Policy Pulse by Jirair

Dear Friends and Supporters,
I want to extend my warmest wishes to all the mothers and mother figures in my family and our community. I hope this **Mother’s Day** is filled with love and joy for you and your families.
Reflecting on the incredible journey of my congressional campaign, I remain overwhelmed with gratitude. After the primary, I took time to rest, reflect, and spend time with my family. This period was not only rejuvenating but also allowed for thoughtful discussions with mentors, friends, and colleagues about the future.
_What am I up to now?_ I am leading policy projects that focus on combating HIV, supporting global development, and ensuring safe and responsible roll out of artificial intelligence. I also remain committed to supporting representation and electing progressive candidates to Congress.
That is why I have joined the Victory Campaign Board and am exploring other board opportunities where I can make a significant impact. As we look ahead to November, I remain focused on supporting efforts to take back the House of Representatives and reelecting President Joe Biden.
I am excited about the opportunities to continue serving our community and advocating for the values we hold dear. I look forward to sharing more developments with you soon and continuing our journey together toward a more equitable, inclusive, and healthy society.
Be well,Jirair
[p.s. I am supporting Biden! Click here for exclusive events for President Biden coming toa city near you. ](https://jirairforca.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9a650c1aa45f33d502f0dc1b3&id=5dfa1ee8dd&e=fc23458ef2)

body:
