May 6, 2024
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
CONTACT: Houston Keene
press@nancyforalaska.com

Mary "Present" Peltola Fails Alaskans Again

ANCHORAGE, AK - Once again, Mary "Present" Peltola failed to stand up
for Alaskans and help pass the "Alaska's Right to Produce Act." In
fact, she ENCOURAGED her Democrat colleagues to vote "no" on the
legislation. Now Peltola's back playing political games instead of
representing the Alaskans who sent her to Washington to be their voice.

For the record, Peltola voted for "Alaska's Right to Produce Act"
during committee, then she encouraged her Democrat colleagues to vote
"No on Alaska", then she voted "present," and then, she skipped
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=67540&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=59523> a House Resources Committee budget
hearing where she failed to stand up for Alaskans during testimony from
Interior Secretary Deb Haaland.

<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=67540&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=59524>

(Fox News
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=67540&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=59524> , 05/02/24)

In response to Peltola's "present" vote, Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom
stated:

"Mary Peltola has put Alaska on the back burner one too many times.
Alaskans deserve representation in Washington that will stand up to Joe
Biden and fight for our state, and we have a chance to make that happen
this November. We can no longer afford to send elected officials to
Washington who will put Alaskan energy jobs last and I can assure you
that this won't be the last time Alaskans are reminded about Peltola's
betrayal of our state."

name: Gary Sinise
subject: The National Memorial Day Parade is back
body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.

Fellow American,

It's Gary Sinise here.

You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo
13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI NY- but it
was in 1994 and playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that
my life changed and inspired my enduring connection to our
defenders, veterans, and first responders.

This year, I'm honored to again serve as an
Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in
Washington, D.C.

The National Memorial Day Parade is an event like
no other … and this year, as we mark the 80th anniversary
of the D-Day invasion, the American Veterans Center is bringing
the Parade BACK in full force, with 5,000+ participants marching
down Constitution Avenue before a crowd of 250,000+ in-person, as
well as a T.V. broadcast that reaches 100 million households
around the country.

Fellow American/Fellow American, the National Memorial Day
Parade is PRIMARILY FUNDED by private contributions, including
from generous Americans like you. Will you help chip in today to
help support the Parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, or
more?

Support the National Memorial Day Parade

Support the National Memorial Day Parade

The National Memorial Day Parade costs a fraction
of other major public events to put on each year. In fact, the
entire parade costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the
Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl
Parade!

That means that every dollar that's contributed by
a generous American like you makes a difference for this
important event.

Your support of the American Veterans Center not
only helps the Parade, but also supports great programs like:

Recording hundreds of oral histories of
veterans from World War II to today before we lose these stories
forever.

Holding our National Youth Summit which allows
young students a chance to hear firsthand from veterans from
WWII, Korea, and Vietnam.

Producing veteran-focused T.V. documentaries
and specials that remind Americans of the price of our freedom.

Please join me in support of the National Memorial
Day Parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, $250, $500, or
more right now.

If you've been looking for an opportunity to give
back to those who have given so much for our freedom, this is one
of the best ways you could possibly do it.

And for a special group of veterans, this might be
one of the last chances we get.

You see, with each year that goes by, we lose more
and more of our World War II veterans, and for the few we have
remaining, traveling to Washington, D.C. for the parade is
difficult.

I am honored to say that we will have several World
War II veterans with us for this year's parade... but I don't
know how many more years we'll have that precious opportunity.

So this year, as we mark the 80th anniversary of
the D-Day invasion and what might be the last chance these great
men have to gather together, I encourage you to help us honor
them while we still have them with us.

Hi Peter, Meeting folks all across Wisconsin is my favorite part of the job — and hearing about their concerns is one of the most important parts, too. It’s a privilege to represent Wisconsinites in the Senate, and I take that role seriously. From connecting with the small business owners to listening to the priorities of working families all over the state, every opinion matters. But I figured sending you a quick email for your thoughts would be the next best thing: **[I want to hear from you, Peter: Can you please take our short May Priorities Survey today? subject: Two Things - Trump and Faith
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Parkinson for Senate
body:
| | |
---
Friend, There's been some more good news out of Mar A Lago! This weekend the Trump campaign once again acknowledged during a donor retreat at Mar A Lago they're expanding the Electoral Map to include pick-up opportunities **VIRGINIA** and Minnesota. The Trump campaign is planning to invest in Virginia to Win Big and Avoid the Rig! When I met with President Trump backstage at his Richmond rally in early March, we talked about defeating Tim Kaine and Joe Biden. I knew he was sincere about the opportunity of winning Virginia and this news substantiates our conversation.
---
---
I've known we can win this race against Tim Kaine ever since I saw Glenn Youngkin defeat Terry McAullife in November 2021. When I considered running for the Senate, a close friend asked me: Why don't you wait ten years? They talked about how I have 4 little kids. They said Tim Kaine is too powerful. He's got millions of dollars in his campaign account. He's connected with the biggest liberal donors from his time running the Democratic National Committee (DNC). Kaine was even Hillary's 2016 running-mate! I thought to myself, we don't have ten years! We have to save our country. It's time to step up and make a difference. Cortlynn and I prayed together about the race. I was reminded of my favorite Bible verse. Matthew 17:20. Jesus said, "Because you have so little faith. Truly I tell you, if you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you." I have the faith that we can win. For the past 13 months, I've been planting mustard seeds all over Virginia. Our campaign is growing. And together - we can move mountains. Fundraising continues to be the most challenging part of running for the Senate. My biggest fear right now isn't Tim Kaine. It's whether we will be able to fund our message to reach enough voters. Will you please consider making a contribution now? Invest in me. Help us win in November and give Donald Trump a Republican Senate Majority that will fulfill the electoral mandate of the American People. Thank you for your generosity and prayers, Scott

Cortlynn and I prayed together about the race. I was reminded of my favorite Bible verse. Matthew 17:20. Jesus said, "Because you have so little faith. Truly I tell you, if you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you." I have the faith that we can win. For the past 13 months, I've been planting mustard seeds all over Virginia. Our campaign is growing. And together - we can move mountains. Fundraising continues to be the most challenging part of running for the Senate. My biggest fear right now isn't Tim Kaine. It's whether we will be able to fund our message to reach enough voters. Will you please consider making a contribution now? Invest in me. Help us win in November and give Donald Trump a Republican Senate Majority that will fulfill the electoral mandate of the American People. Thank you for your generosity and prayers, Scott | | Paid for by Parkinson for Senate | |

# FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Reader, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don't wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

**CAMPAIGN UPDATES FOR MAY 6, 2024**
Statement from Flemming Larsen: I was heartbroken and angry after the terrorist attacks on innocent Israeli men, women, and children on October 7th. Now, we are witnessing our college campuses--including UNLV--becoming hotbeds of support for Hamas, and this must stop. In Congress, I will introduce legislation to cut off federal funding to universities and colleges that tolerate calls for genocide, as we are currently witnessing. While left-wing extremists and terrorist sympathizers have long found a haven on college campuses, they now have an ally in Congresswoman Dina Titus. As Hamas held both Israeli and U.S. citizens hostage, Titus voted against providing urgently-needed military aid to Israel. Now, with Joe Biden freezing military support for Israel because they refuse to agree to a one-sided 'ceasefire' with terrorists, his Nevada campaign chair, Dina Titus, remains silent. In Congress, I will be an ally to Jews who are being terrorized on college campuses and in public spaces here, as well as to the nation of Israel, our best friend in a region where both of our freedom-loving democracies are equally despised. ___________________________________________________________________

We're turning up the heat as we close in on the primary \- only 36 days away! Have you registered to vote Republican? More and more signs continue to go up all over Congressional District 1. Campaign signs influence how we vote more than you might realize. Signs provide a sense of name recognition and convey a sense of viability and electability. Signs are an important part of this campaign, and we need donations to continue pursuing the marketing efforts we have already started. If you would like to contribute by displaying a yard sign, please contact Christina Davis at [christina@larsen4nevada.com](mailto:christina@larsen4nevada.com). If you would like to donate in support of our larger signs, please click here: [Donate Today!](https://contact.larsenfornevada.com/l/Bgp56XeTOWHuDL1xwwPvEQ/0g3892sfQen4Xr8zX45kTjkQ/igCRdxK8923ZIbCQyl90RmEQ)
|

**ENJOYING TIME TO CELEBRATE WITH OTHER CANDIDATES**

Citizen Outreach's annual fun-filled, action-packed, star-studded conservative awards dinner was held on Wednesday, May 1. Here's a shoutout to the winners:
* Conservative of the Year: **Iris Stone**
* Reagan Legacy Award: **Sig Rogich**
* Courage Under Fire: **Valeria Gurr**
* Rising Star: Assemblywoman **Danielle Gallant**
* Unsung Hero: **Jon Kamerath**

A surprise "Shield of Valor" award was presented honoring a very special Metro police officer. On March 29, 2024, K-9 dog "**Enzo** " was stabbed eight or nine times after being dispatched to take down a man wielding a knife who set his apartment on fire and was threatening Enzo's fellow police officers. The award was announced by Assembly candidate **Kelly Chapman** and accepted by Assembly candidate and retired Henderson police detective **April Arndt**.
|

**UPCOMING EVENTS**

On Thursday, May 16th, come join us at Boulder City Republican Women's luncheon before the club breaks for summer! A very important meeting before the Primary! Flemming will be a guest speaker at this event.
|

Hey - my name is Byron Donalds.

As Co-Chair of one of the most important initiatives of the Republican Party, I wanted you to what we're doing right now to lay the groundwork for the biggest GOP landslide in AMERICAN HISTORY!

_**[A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen- so bear with me for a minute:](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkTGLpjAQhn9N7CKTxEQtLBYW4Yo9Fq64MkQzn99ATCSJ7v78w-O2umrLYXifdx7m95t9cxQobj_djhOVYnOx9bJldYH7FPmWDr64EFK1EmTHQXMwVjR-0lIMj6HBSfRCg9QwQvOcFocwOtUtHh8LqEWbtVcOh9F0Ti--b2i6OaDBiBEEDK2UbgQjjRqNWDQ8WAfn4V3FlmIhj2VN6ThSoEpraVPemjA9az0KUy9MzkzOBdczY_tBMaNv17QzOVd0O78tqCCTs0_RBV_-qfCnyxeWSnG7CWrONyHfo3qt-UQmzVl3u7r9cLRFpl6_jrbvL_zHr3fRCqGM6mwV3aCMBi56bZg0-Gkr-W8E_vakWDHWu_ziVAr_CjNpPs94_b9o8uSPDwqBiulZB9vuKNzqTf3GF_8EAAD__3V2naE "A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen – so bear with me for a minute:")**_

-> If the Democrat Legal Machine tries any shenanigans, we'll be there to stop them
-> If Liberals can ballot harvest, we should ballot harvest even better
-> If they're sending poll watchers, we should send an army of our own
-> We're not pandering to minority voters, we're building relationships with them
-> We're expanding GOTV efforts to get young Conservatives to the ballot box
-> We're fighting bad election laws to make it easier to vote but harder to cheat

These are the nuts and bolts of winning campaigns up and down the ballot. And I'm proud to help lead these efforts.

As Conservatives, we have the issues on our side. We are the only commonsense Party. **If we get these campaign operations right, the Democrats are in serious trouble come election day.**

_But I have to be honest with you: building this level of infrastructure is very expensive._ We're running ads in costly swing-state markets, printing campaign literature, filling up gas tanks to knock doors, recruiting volunteers, and scaling up our voter contact programs.

And unlike the Democrats, we don't rely on Liberal billionaires and rich celebrities for funding.

I'm perfectly okay with that. But it means if we want to WIN BIG, the burden falls on all of us to step up. _**[That's why I'm coming to you now - would you be willing to pitch in a few bucks to help kick start these efforts? Whether it's 10 bucks or 100 bucks, I only ask that everyone pitches in SOMETHING.](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkTGLpjAQhn9N7CKTxEQtLBYW4Yo9Fq64MkQzn99ATCSJ7v78w-O2umrLYXifdx7m95t9cxQobj_djhOVYnOx9bJldYH7FPmWDr64EFK1EmTHQXMwVjR-0lIMj6HBSfRCg9QwQvOcFocwOtUtHh8LqEWbtVcOh9F0Ti--b2i6OaDBiBEEDK2UbgQjjRqNWDQ8WAfn4V3FlmIhj2VN6ThSoEpraVPemjA9az0KUy9MzkzOBdczY_tBMaNv17QzOVd0O78tqCCTs0_RBV_-qfCnyxeWSnG7CWrONyHfo3qt-UQmzVl3u7r9cLRFpl6_jrbvL_zHr3fRCqGM6mwV3aCMBi56bZg0-Gkr-W8E_vakWDHWu_ziVAr_CjNpPs94_b9o8uSPDwqBiulZB9vuKNzqTf3GF_8EAAD__3V2naE "That’s why I’m coming to you now – would you be willing to pitch in a few bucks to help kick start these efforts? Whether it’s 10 bucks or 100 bucks, I only ask that everyone pitches in SOMETHING.")**_

Look,

**I know it 's a lot to ask but I GUARANTEE it'll all be worth it when we expand our Conservative Majority, take back control of the Senate, and win the White House.**

I don't know about you but the thought of unified Republican control fires me up! If that doesn't convince you to want to help, I don't know what will! Are you in?

| | | Friend, I was in my second year at West Point, huddled around the TV in my barracks, when a hijacked plane hit the Twin Towers. **I knew then that my fellow cadets and I would be the next class to see war.** Upon graduation, I was deployed to Operation Iraqi Freedom as an AH-64D Apache Pilot. I spent 8 years fighting for our freedom, only to see what America has become under Joe Biden.
* Our economy is on the verge of ruin as the socialists infect their failed ideology into American life.

body:
[1]Powered By People

I’m writing to invite you to a special meeting on May 14th where I’ll
share with you what our volunteers have been doing to bring new Democratic
voters on to the voting rolls and how we’re going to help turn these
voters out in November.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63445?utm_source=ema20240506-239575&t=1001&akid=239575%2E444211%2Ex4qf5c ]Sign up today to join our May 14th meeting.

Ahead of an election that will decide the Senate majority, the Presidency
and control of the House, we are going to make the most effective use of
our time and resources to bring in and turn out Texas voters who could be
the margin of victory in close races across the state.

I want you to be part of this effort. We'll be stronger and more
successful if you’re part of the team. When you join us on the 14th, I’ll
share with you how our program works and how you can be a part of it.

I’ll also share with you what we’ve learned from the last few years of
organizing and registering voters. We’re getting smarter, better, more
effective, and I’m confident we have a program that is going to make a
significant difference in Democrats’ ability to win elections in Texas.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63445?utm_source=ema20240506-239575&t=1002&akid=239575%2E444211%2Ex4qf5c ]Sign up today to join our May 14th meeting.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63445?utm_source=ema20240506-239575&t=1003&akid=239575%2E444211%2Ex4qf5c ]Sign Up

Ahead of our special May 14th meeting, I’ve spent the last two weeks
traveling Texas, working with our volunteers all over the state to make
sure our program is ready for you. I am committed to making sure that we
use your volunteer time as effectively and efficiently as possible. And
after seeing our program in action, and participating in it as a volunteer
myself, I’m confident we will.

I look forward to seeing you on the 14th and working with you as hard and
as smart as we can over the next six months.

See you soon,

Beto

name: David Hogg
subject: Announcing our second round of 2024 endorsements
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Check out the full list of endorsements and show your support.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240506-1&t=1&akid=656%2E587540%2EMYAtGJ)
Peter,
When we announced our first slate of 2024 endorsements several weeks back, this team really rose to the occasion and showed massive support for our candidates.
I have every reason to believe that supporters like you will do the same thing for our brand-new slate of endorsements in competitive districts across the country.
**Without further ado, we’re revealing our second round of 2024 candidates![(If you don’t have time to read more about them below, you can still donate $5 to support our work.)](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240506-1?refcode=em20240506-1&amount=5&refcode2=656_587540_MYAtGJ&akid=656%2E587540%2EMYAtGJ)**
[****](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240506-1?refcode=em20240506-1&amount=5&refcode2=656_587540_MYAtGJ&akid=656%2E587540%2EMYAtGJ)
**Luis Mata (TN HD-49 – Murfreesboro)**
Luis Mata is a lifelong community advocate who is running for the state legislature to build a stronger Tennessee. Raised by a single mother who immigrated to Tennessee from Mexico, he learned the values of hard work, resilience, and unity. If elected, he’d be the first and only Latino state legislator in Tennessee.
**Allie Phillips (TN HD-75 – Clarksville)**
Allie Phillips is a mom and Tennessee native who is running for office to make much-needed change in her community and her state. When she was 19 weeks pregnant, she learned that her unborn daughter was not compatible with life. Because of her state’s draconian abortion ban, she was forced to travel 900 miles to terminate the pregnancy. She is fighting for reproductive freedom to make sure no one else has to experience the same traumatic situation she did.
**Molly Cook (TX SD-15 – Houston)**
Molly Cook is a Democrat, an ER nurse, and a community organizer running for the Texas Senate because she has seen too many of her patients suffer preventable harm as a direct result of bad policy. She already won a special election for this seat, but needs our support to win a runoff and the general election. If elected, she will be the youngest – and most progressive – member of the Texas Senate.
**Nate Douglas (FL HD-37 – Orlando)**
Nate Douglas is a climate organizer and policy researcher running for the Florida Legislature because he was raised by his first-generation American parents to believe in fairness and freedom – and he has seen too many freedoms being stripped away in his state, from book bans to attacks on abortion rights and the LGBTQ+ community. If he wins, he’ll be the youngest legislator in Florida.
**Dante Pittman (NC HD-24 – Wilson)**
Dante Pittman is a community leader whose family has called North Carolina home for generations. He is running for the state legislature to make life easier for folks in eastern North Carolina by advocating for affordable housing, public education, and economic opportunity. This is going to be the most competitive legislative race in the state this year, and a win here could block a GOP supermajority.
**Oscar De Los Santos (AZ HD-11 – Phoenix)**
Oscar De Los Santos is an internationally-recognized leader and the incumbent in Arizona’s 11th legislative district. He is a proven fighter for working families, voting rights, fair wages for teachers, and equality for all Arizonans. In April, he helped reverse Arizona’s draconian 1864 abortion law and became a new target for the GOP. We’re going to help him defend this seat so he can keep making progress.
[**I am personally setting a $24,000 fundraising goal to build a strong foundation of support for all of our 2024 Leaders We Deserve candidates. If you’re ready to join our fight to elect these young, progressive leaders, pitch in $5 now.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240506-1?refcode=em20240506-1&amount=5&refcode2=656_587540_MYAtGJ&akid=656%2E587540%2EMYAtGJ)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240506-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240506-1-656&refcode2=656_587540_MYAtGJ&akid=656%2E587540%2EMYAtGJ)**
These candidates – and everyone we’re supporting in 2024 – are the leaders we deserve. We’ve already been on the ground – with Molly in Houston and Nate in Orlando – helping these inspiring young candidates build successful campaigns. Witnessing the enthusiasm for their bold new leadership has been so rewarding. I can’t wait to see the progress they make after we help them win these elections.
**We’re pouring everything we can into electing these young leaders all across the country**. We spent more than $100,000 to help elect Nadarius Clark in Virginia last year. We’re prepared to make _major investments_ for all of our candidates.
I am so inspired by and proud of all 12 of our endorsed candidates – and you can expect us to announce even more endorsements in the coming months. There are so many incredible young people rising up to run for office, but they need a strong bedrock of support to defy the odds, break down barriers, and win these races.
[**Reaching our $24,000 goal this week is absolutely vital – because it’s going to take a lot of resources to propel these campaigns to victory. Peter, pitch in $5 or whatever you can right now to elect the next generation of leaders!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240506-1?refcode=em20240506-1&amount=5&refcode2=656_587540_MYAtGJ&akid=656%2E587540%2EMYAtGJ)
Thank you!!
David Hogg
Leaders We Deserve

# FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Reader, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don't wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

Like many, my partner Paolo and I came of age at a time when being gay was still considered a crime in many states.

I often reflect back to when I was 17 years old in the wake of 9/11. I had a deep sense of duty to serve the country, but policies like “Don’t Ask, Don’t Tell” discouraged me from joining the military.

Thanks to the brave LGBTQ+ Americans who came before me and had the courage to come out, I eventually got the chance to work openly in law enforcement and counterterrorism.

• Is on record supporting the _criminalization_ of sexual acts between consenting LGBTQ+ adults,

• Previously worked with an organization that pushed so-called conversion therapy,

• Claimed that a ‘homosexual agenda’ will destroy society and likened being LGBTQ+ to pedophilia and bestiality. _Really._

The fact that the Speaker of the House doesn’t respect Paolo's and my right to love is shocking -- especially in 2024. And the fact that Ken Calvert and the entire Republican Party handed him the Speaker’s gavel is even more horrifying.

clean_body: | Peter, Like many, my partner Paolo and I came of age at a time when being gay was still considered a crime in many states. I often reflect back to when I was 17 years old in the wake of 9/11. I had a deep sense of duty to serve the country, but policies like “Don’t Ask, Don’t Tell” discouraged me from joining the military. Thanks to the brave LGBTQ+ Americans who came before me and had the courage to come out, I eventually got the chance to work openly in law enforcement and counterterrorism. = Paolo and I recently at Palm Springs Pride. Despite the strides we've taken toward equality, the recent election of Speaker Mike Johnson proves the GOP is hell-bent on turning back the clock on LGBTQ+ rights. Johnson’s record reads like something out of an anti-LGBTQ+ hate group’s wish list. Aside from voting against marriage equality just last year, he: • Is on record supporting the criminalization of sexual acts between consenting LGBTQ+ adults, • Previously worked with an organization that pushed so-called conversion therapy, • Claimed that a ‘homosexual agenda’ will destroy society and likened being LGBTQ+ to pedophilia and bestiality. Really. The fact that the Speaker of the House doesn’t respect Paolo's and my right to love is shocking -- especially in 2024. And the fact that Ken Calvert and the entire Republican Party handed him the Speaker’s gavel is even more horrifying. We can send a clear message that rejects Johnson’s hateful agenda by turning the House blue next year. Peter,

I hope this email finds you well. I wanted to take a moment to share some important news regarding recent legislative developments and their impact on our way of life in New Mexico and the West.

First, I want to applaud the work of the U.S. House for passing the WEST Act, a significant piece of legislation aimed at safeguarding our public lands and protecting the interests of communities like ours here in New Mexico.

_**Here’s why it’s so important and how it affects us:**_

1. **Stopping Biden’s Land Grab:** The WEST Act protects westerners against Joe Biden’s radical attempts to take control of our land. They’ve been trying to put rules in place that would make it hard for us to use our land how we want: farming, outdoor fun, grazing animals, and energy production. This would devastate families, small businesses, and multi-generation ranches. But not anymore thanks to the WEST Act.
2. **Less Red Tape:** The new law also cuts down on a bunch of complicated rules and regulations that are unnecessary and burdensome. Less red tape means less hassle and more time for us to focus on what matters most when it comes to our own land.
3. **Standing Up for Ourselves:** Before passing the WEST Act, the Biden administration’s “Bureau of Land Management” refused to interact with local stakeholders and made zero attempts to listen to the local communities they were affecting. Now, unelected bureaucrats can no longer decide what’s best for us. This bill puts the power back in the hands of the People.

**The bottom line:_this bill is a major win for New Mexicans and the entire West._** We need more legislation like this, and I’m eager to champion it as your next Congresswoman.

Thank you for taking the time to read this update, and feel free to share this information with others who may be interested.

Best regards,

_**Yvette Herrell**_

# May Day Solidarity and Mental Health
---

Voters are 52 days away from casting their first ballots for me in the primary election!
My wife Peggy and I have been hitting the campaign trail hard, bouncing around city to city to connect with voters at coffee hours, meet and greets, and town halls to earn support and learn about rural voters' everyday issues.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/Lorinser%20Face.png]
I am a fierce proponent of campaign finance reform. To win and continue our unprecedented momentum, we require a lot of resources to keep fuel in the tank. We need your help to keep us going.
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process immediately.
DONATE NOW $2.24 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/q1bl?express_lane=true&amount=2.24&refcode=express_lane_2.24]
DONATE NOW $20.24 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/q1bl?express_lane=true&amount=20.24&refcode=express_lane_20.24]
DONATE NOW $202.40 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/q1bl?express_lane=true&amount=202.40&refcode=express_lane_202.40]
DONATE NOW $2,024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/q1bl?express_lane=true&amount=2024&refcode=express_lane_2024]
Friends,
I'm on the road making my case about why I have the most winnable campaign to preserve Social Security and Medicare and make life easier for everyday hardworking people. We're fighting for universal healthcare, affordable housing, public education, and childcare.
The issues will win this campaign, and we're fighting hard to maintain a positive, issue-focused campaign. We're fighting harder than ever before because I have never been more energized to defeat Trumpism in rural Michigan.
We have 52 days before the first early voters begin casting their ballots. It's time for us to rally together, organize, energize, and mobilize. The momentum is palpable. We're publishing daily endorsements from mayors, State Reps, commissioners, law enforcement, veterans, and candidates in every county.
Whether through an endorsement of your own, volunteering, or a generous contribution, your support today is crucial to our campaign's success. We can't do this without you. [https://linktr.ee/boblorinser]
At the doors, our canvassers hear overwhelmingly positive responses in our favor. We have been working hard and investing a lot to get to every voter from every corner of the district. In a district the size of Ireland, with 40% of the landmass of Michigan, we have a lot of work to do, and it requires your support.
I do not accept a dime from corporate PACs or dark money, so I rely solely on the generosity of grassroots supporters like you.
It's truly crunch time. Thank you for considering a contribution today. I'm available to chat; if you need to discuss anything further, please reply and send me a line. I'm happy to chat.
Thank you. I need you now more than ever.
-Bob

Peter,

In a recent interview with TIME Magazine, former President Donald Trump said that he would allow states to monitor women’s pregnancies and prosecute them for violating abortion bans.

These are attacks on our fundamental rights, including the right to choose and the right to privacy.

**In the wake of the _Dobbs_ decision, we knew it was not just about abortion. We knew this decision would lead to controlling women’s choices and taking away more freedoms. We’ve already seen state legislatures suggest bills that would jail women who received abortions, and we’ve seen attacks on IVF and emergency contraception.**

However, we know this isn’t what the majority of Americans want – because we saw what happened in states like Kansas and Ohio when abortion was on the ballot. The majority of Americans trust women to make their own choices — without interference from politicians and judges.

This is what’s at stake in our upcoming election, and as long as these attacks on our rights continue and until our fundamental freedoms are once again protected, reproductive rights are on the ballot in every state across the country.

[_**As Governor of Virginia, I will protect a woman’s right to choose and make sure that reproductive healthcare remains safe, legal, and accessible. These are attacks on our fundamental rights, including the right to choose and the right to privacy. In the wake of the Dobbs decision, we knew it was not just about abortion. We knew this decision would lead to controlling women’s choices and taking away more freedoms. We’ve already seen state legislatures suggest bills that would jail women who received abortions, and we’ve seen attacks on IVF and emergency contraception. However, we know this isn’t what the majority of Americans want – because we saw what happened in states like Kansas and Ohio when abortion was on the ballot. The majority of Americans trust women to make their own choices — without interference from politicians and judges. This is what’s at stake in our upcoming election, and as long as these attacks on our rights continue and until our fundamental freedoms are once again protected, reproductive rights are on the ballot in every state across the country. = | | = | = | = | | = | = | = | = Thank you, Abigail * | | Paid for by Spanberger for Governor Spanberger for Governor P.O. body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=6397%2E5257348%2E9_XC-j ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek, like so
many Americans, I know from experience that when you’re dealing with a
family health emergency, the last thing you need to be worrying about is
the insurance bill or how you’re going to pay for it.

You see, when my daughter Lexi was only five, she had her tonsils removed.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=may2024_abs_em.HG8rlH&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240506_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=6397%2E5257348%2E9_XC-j ]Adam and his daughter Lexi

I remember the doctor telling us that there was a very, very small chance
that she could begin bleeding from where she had them removed in a couple
weeks, which can be very serious. I remember thinking “This wasn't gonna
happen to our kid.”

Well, it did happen.

That day, I took Lexi to the emergency room and stood there with her while
she bled profusely from the mouth. To make matters worse, they told us
they didn't have enough medical staff and couldn't help her right away.

We eventually went to our local children's hospital and they took good
care of her — and thankfully, she was fine.

We were lucky to have good, quality care that day — and that I had health
insurance so that we wouldn’t have to worry about medical bills. But
unfortunately, that’s not the reality for millions of families across our
country.

We are the richest nation in the world, and health care should be a right
— not a privilege.

I’m running for the U.S. Senate to fight for Medicare for All so that
every family can seek the care they need when they need it. No one should
have to compromise between the health of their family and making ends
meet.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=may2024_abs_em.HG8rlH&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240506_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=1005&akid=6397%2E5257348%2E9_XC-j ]I need to know you’re with me in the fight to make sure every American
has affordable, quality health care. So what do you say,

$10 so

clean_body: [ ]Adam Schiff for Senate Derek, like so many Americans, I know from experience that when you’re dealing with a family health emergency, the last thing you need to be worrying about is the insurance bill or how you’re going to pay for it. You see, when my daughter Lexi was only five, she had her tonsils removed. [ ]Adam and his daughter Lexi I remember the doctor telling us that there was a very, very small chance that she could begin bleeding from where she had them removed in a couple weeks, which can be very serious. I remember thinking “This wasn't gonna happen to our kid.” Well, it did happen. That day, I took Lexi to the emergency room and stood there with her while she bled profusely from the mouth. To make matters worse, they told us they didn't have enough medical staff and couldn't help her right away. We eventually went to our local children's hospital and they took good care of her — and thankfully, she was fine. We were lucky to have good, quality care that day — and that I had health insurance so that we wouldn’t have to worry about medical bills. But unfortunately, that’s not the reality for millions of families across our country. We are the richest nation in the world, and health care should be a right — not a privilege. I’m running for the U.S. Senate to fight for Medicare for All so that every family can seek the care they need when they need it. No one should have to compromise between the health of their family and making ends meet. [ ]I need to know you’re with me in the fight to make sure every American has affordable, quality health care. So what do you say, Derek: Will you pitch in $10 so that I can make it to the Senate and fight for Medicare for All? **Dear Friends** \-
I'm writing to personally share the news that I am running for Congress. My entry into the race was a relatively quick decision, spurred by the retirement of the six-term incumbent congresswoman who represents my district.
Like many of you, I've been frustrated by the overwhelming dysfunction in Washington, DC and deeply believe we can do better. Despite the long list of disappointing developments happening in the United States today, I'm fundamentally an **optimist** and deeply believe that America, while not perfect, is an exceptional country that is genuinely a land of opportunity. It's the shining city on a hill that drew my parents here more than 50 years ago and continues to be a beacon of hope for so many people.
[I'm running for Congress](https://substack.com/redirect/2e09430d-b128-4a42-9cd0-829825dc31e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to help overcome some of the most pressing challenges we face as a nation, and to do so in way that moves beyond today's deep polarization and problematic partisanship. _There are three main topics I plan to focus upon_**: 1) Border security and immigration reform, 2) Fiscal discipline and economic growth,** and**3) Foreign affairs and national security.** All three of these topics are characterized by extremely divisive discussions that present policy options in either-or language. Well, I'm a believer in **both-and** thinking.
We can, for instance, have **both** a _secure border_ **and** a _welcoming legal immigration policy_. We can also have a government that **both** _lives within its means_ **and** _invests in services and infrastructure that Americans depend upon_. And lastly, we can have a foreign policy that **both** _puts American interests_ _first_ **and** _supports_ _our allies_.
**Enough is enough**. It's time to move beyond the tired and disruptive partisan politics and get back to a government that works for Americans, not for career politicians. I hope you'll support me in my quest to fix the mess we find ourselves in and to move beyond the false tradeoffs presented by today's dysfunctional system. Unfortunately, I can't do much on my own. But together, I believe we can do anything we set out to accomplish.
**I 'm writing to seek your help**. I've waited for almost a month before emailing because I wanted to have a response to a dear friend and consistent supporter. When I informed him I was running, he graciously offered to support my campaign, but was also kind enough to add some encouraging words: "But don't f&ck*&g lose!"
While I can't make any guarantees, I'm pleased to share that I'm making progress at addressing my friend's concern. In the past three weeks, my campaign has hit the ground running and has announced [more than 60 endorsements from prominent leaders from different wings of the Republican Party, something local press has called a "broad coalition.](https://substack.com/redirect/3fb842d1-fae1-41e0-b2cc-c06317f124bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" Further, several of the state's most active businessmen have been helping me financially, and the campaign is off to a great start. And lastly, I've started building a team that's among the best in the country. Political analysts have begun to take notice.
I'm specifically seeking help in three ways:
1. **MONEY**. Campaigns are expensive! We are seeking additional resources to hire more organizers, launch a mail campaign, and begin a broadcast advertising effort. To those who have already donated, thank you! For everyone else, I really need your help! To contribute electronically, please click this link: **[https://secure.anedot.com/vikram4nh/cbd9f98c480ee1ea0a069](https://substack.com/redirect/3d8c0492-543a-47ef-939f-d80db7df5403?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ DONATE NOW!](https://substack.com/redirect/3d8c0492-543a-47ef-939f-d80db7df5403?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
2. **INTRODUCTIONS**. I need to get a large number of donors to acquire the financial resources needed to mount a winning campaign. Feel free to send this email along to other civic-minded folks in your network, or pass their names along to me and I'll happily email or call. One of the most powerful ways to help is to get multiple friends to also contribute to my effort!

3. **SUMMER (AND BEYOND!) HELP.** I am in need of ambitious young professionals who are eager to spend the Summer (and Fall if they're available!) working on an exciting campaign in beautiful New Hampshire. Perhaps you know college students (or recent graduates) who are looking for an interesting opportunity? [Please point them towards me!](https://substack.com/redirect/8e084c61-06a5-47fc-8919-c7d3e90226f5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

**VIKRAM MANSHARAMANI **is an entrepreneur, consultant, scholar, neighbor, husband, father, volunteer, and professional generalist who thinks in multiple-dimensions and looks beyond the short-term. Self-taught to think around corners and connect original dots, he spends his time speaking with global leaders in business, government, academia, and journalism. _LinkedIn_ has twice listed him as its #1 Top Voice in Money & Finance, and _Worth_ profiled him as one of the 100 Most Powerful People in Global Finance. Vikram earned a PhD From MIT, has taught at Yale and Harvard, and is the author of three books, _**[The Making of a Generalist: An Independent Thinker Finds Unconventional Success in an Uncertain World](https://substack.com/redirect/24a7cd11-4f26-4955-a8e4-57b1accbeaae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_ , _**[Think for Yourself: Restoring Common Sense in an Age of Experts and Artificial Intelligence](https://substack.com/redirect/16871708-e4a3-472d-8088-ca05d20f4877?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_ and _**[Boombustology: Spotting Financial Bubbles Before They Burst](https://substack.com/redirect/b9050092-d69b-40db-b5f5-73d56fca3c06?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_. Vikram lives in Lincoln, New Hampshire with his wife and two children, where they can usually be found hiking or skiing.
You're currently a free subscriber to [Navigating Uncertainty](https://substack.com/redirect/22057031-cf28-488b-b837-48d7bc30b5e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). name: Jill Stein
subject: An urgent message from Jill
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
This is the most critical moment of our campaign.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0506_ny_ba_appeal_all_supporte&n=1)
---
Peter, **Right now is probably the most critical, urgent moment of our campaign. We need all hands on deck to get on the ballot in New York. **As you may know, shortly after taking full control of NY state government Andrew Cuomo and the NY Democrats tripled the ballot access requirement to 45,000 signatures in a 6-week period, making NY arguably the most difficult state to get on the ballot. Halfway through the petitioning period, we are behind where we need to be. With just three weeks to clear this hurdle by the May 28th deadline, we need everyone to do what they can to help now. **Our most critical need right now is for people to collect signatures in New York.** We are looking for volunteers as well as people who would like to get paid to petition. **If you can come petition in New York, we need your help!** Let us know if you’re willing to help collect signatures in NY and we’ll get in touch to make arrangements for your visit, including accommodations if you need them.******Please sign up to help now:**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/nyballot?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0506_ny_ba_appeal_all_supporte&n=2 "HELP JILL GET ON THE NY BALLOT") [HELP JILL GET ON THE NY BALLOT](https://www.jillstein2024.com/nyballot?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0506_ny_ba_appeal_all_supporte&n=2)
---
**We also need everyone to donate whatever they can to help us fund this urgent ballot drive.** Every dollar you can donate helps move us closer to the all-important goal of getting 45,000 valid signatures in New York. **Please pitch in as much as you can now to help make it happen!**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donation_ny?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0506_ny_ba_appeal_all_supporte&n=3 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donation_ny?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0506_ny_ba_appeal_all_supporte&n=3)
---
**Our campaign is finally starting to break through after months of hard work.** A recent CBS poll from Wisconsin had us at 8% in a 3-way race, including 22% among voters 18-30 and 16% among voters 30-44. Since I was arrested with my campaign manager and deputy campaign manager last week in St. Louis, we’ve had a flood of media inquiries and back-to-back interviews with major media outlets. We got a big endorsement from world-renowned Columbia University Professor Jeffrey Sachs, and we’ve raised over $100,000 just in the last week. People seem to be waking up to the fact that ours is the one anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate action campaign with a real shot of being on the ballot in every state this November. **But it all depends on what happens in the next three weeks in New York.** If we hit our goal in New York, we’re well on the way to nationwide ballot access - which would make us the first Green presidential campaign to achieve this milestone. With multiple systemic crises hitting at the same time and rejection of the establishment candidates at a record high, the sky is the limit for what lies ahead in this race - including a real shot at the White House. Whether it’s visiting a small business or listening to people’s stories at a roundtable, my favorite part of hitting the campaign trail is connecting with Pennsylvanians.
It’s inspiring to hear about what’s driving folks to the polls, and these conversations remind me why I’m fighting for the people of our Commonwealth in the Senate.
My least favorite part of campaigning, however, is asking for money -- but a large majority of our donations come from people like you chipping in $5 to emails like this one.

Your grassroots support is key to building a winning campaign, and we must win because **there is no Democratic Senate majority without winning in Pennsylvania.**
National Republicans from Donald Trump to Jim Jordan know this, and they’re uniting behind my opponent to buy this seat and flip the Senate red.
I know we can win, but we’re going to have to fight for every single vote and push back against every single dollar that my mega-millionaire opponent and his billionaire backers are going to spend. Nancy Pelosi [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP42/1/88466/images/Speaker%20Emerita%20logo.png]

Dear Friends,

It was with great appreciation that I received the Presidential Medal of Freedom from our great and patriotic President of the United States Joe Biden. The Medal is an honor that is respected because it is about America’s highest value: freedom.

Freedom was the vision of our founders, is the purpose of our men and women in uniform, and is our promise to our children. It is with reverence for freedom and respect for those who have received the Medal of Freedom that I am deeply honored.

I am grateful to my family, constituents, and supporters who make my public service possible. United by our love of country and abiding respect for Democracy and the Constitution, we will always give “proof through the night that our flag is still there,” with liberty and justice for all.

Nancy being honored the Presidential Medal of Freedom [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP42/1/88466/images/20240506_em_ex_b2_pelosi_30_grassroots.jpg]

Thank you for your support,
Nancy
Speaker Emerita Nancy Pelosi is the U.S. Representative for California’s 11th District.
She's fighting to help working families and protect America from the dangerous agenda of House Republicans.

| | | [](http://links.gopwinning.org/u/click?_t=ea36c899de41479ca8c7218c6a20a10b&_m=7cc1a0c4b5f7445faa832a5f142de239&_e=7trY-roNX7y-V5WXLbx5_kZ4fXVyOqanDMJH1isDv9giwsNzqXb2QuWgZYa7W98mL6LasB13Cxo1Moqo3mfMtLl2Io56cnuGmTuT1Ttx6xIRFT2AYMYXIrS4OE6RSy1-jCxxWaOCr-did8mJFQHGbsY88WMK7qYTVYqkeXOIX64tQpVc9WWPktvcdGwKHlJCQ0uqWTeCZk2hCjf8XICdNs1wktRMEGI2QxU5PVs_vdLqVzqRhSdjU4x3XCSTPU3vFnRU6A2BAmxELYwVrcfmEA%3D%3D)
---
Friend, I was 23 years old when I got the call - my husband Scotty's Army unit was ambushed by a suicide bomber. When I showed up at Walter Reed Hospital, he was in a coma, and his eyes were pierced by shrapnel. With Scotty unable to vouch for himself, I was his only advocate. I experienced government dysfunction for the first time while fighting for my husband's rights as a wounded soldier. My name is Tiffany Smiley. When my husband was critically wounded in Iraq, the government elite tried to hold my family back from the care we deserved. **But we fought the establishment bureaucracy - and won.** Since that day, I've dedicated my life to changing how government works for veterans and their families. **Now, I 'm ready to take that fight to Capitol Hill. I'm running for Congress to secure the American Dream not just for our veterans and gold star families, but for EVERY American who has been failed by the system.**
---
[**SUPPORT TIFFANY SMILEY'S CAMPAIGN**](http://links.gopwinning.org/u/click?_t=ea36c899de41479ca8c7218c6a20a10b&_m=7cc1a0c4b5f7445faa832a5f142de239&_e=7trY-roNX7y-V5WXLbx5_kZ4fXVyOqanDMJH1isDv9giwsNzqXb2QuWgZYa7W98mL6LasB13Cxo1Moqo3mfMtLl2Io56cnuGmTuT1Ttx6xIRFT2AYMYXIrS4OE6RSy1-zODD2jJNNExSQE4KZa_KYV3mZRnT1ikkaTYr3EBaDNRa5YhiFp2bg497e7Z-4cYWHCCtwWMq99O1CP56AA2KUohyiFyO0dJwMMWCaZsD0CTilMzMJdwbNnRpaf_8B64_RGTGYko4v_Gf4BxrqFY8LA%3D%3D)
---
Sometimes it seems like the harder we fight, the worse things are getting.

The swamp, the bureaucracy, and grandstanding politicians are picking away at the American Dream. We're spending money we don't have while our border is wide open and bringing crime and drugs to our cities. Families are struggling with ever-increasing prices while homeless veterans sleep on the streets. It doesn't matter how dark our days are - I still believe in America and want better for our kids. I've worked to change the government from the outside for almost twenty years, but now I'm ready to deliver real change for hard-working Washington families. **[I'm very excited about this news and I hope you will join me, Scotty, and our kids in supporting my conservative campaign for Congress!](http://links.gopwinning.org/u/click?_t=ea36c899de41479ca8c7218c6a20a10b&_m=7cc1a0c4b5f7445faa832a5f142de239&_e=7trY-roNX7y-V5WXLbx5_kZ4fXVyOqanDMJH1isDv9giwsNzqXb2QuWgZYa7W98mL6LasB13Cxo1Moqo3mfMtLl2Io56cnuGmTuT1Ttx6xIRFT2AYMYXIrS4OE6RSy1-uwKSObTM4pRwwRE1iSmD27dvgOcO08O7SgG2xop7qaeXAdraJAUpIiX01g8KLiGhvTzLb9nrWKpMqBOjk0efrrEE4NoDhUNJD6_8jwT9HG338i4ASWFOvwAiVcXemoqofJxignkydALU5DRHUmqh5w%3D%3D)**
---
[**SUPPORT TIFFANY SMILEY**](http://links.gopwinning.org/u/click?_t=ea36c899de41479ca8c7218c6a20a10b&_m=7cc1a0c4b5f7445faa832a5f142de239&_e=7trY-roNX7y-V5WXLbx5_kZ4fXVyOqanDMJH1isDv9giwsNzqXb2QuWgZYa7W98mL6LasB13Cxo1Moqo3mfMtLl2Io56cnuGmTuT1Ttx6xIRFT2AYMYXIrS4OE6RSy1-Um8CrCvMIksQ4yInLho9UNmo0qZ4nnPfjHMf4LrNa53EdjJA3q3OqF4a2y2j25uuCI8t7KEEXPDTizcoD_DRNsJxJJzhjzJ3PnAGxO3ZHlmchLdgP2geLTBy_SoaxiuYYEiKqIKI88rjgxK_D_wyJA%3D%3D)

name: Jamison Carrier
subject: I humbly ask for your vote
body:
| | | |
---
| Fellow Hoosier-
I'm just getting back home from knocking on doors and wanted to send you a quick message.
Since launching our campaign in early February, my team and I have traveled to every corner of this district repeatedly. We've attended events, met with local business leaders, stood with law enforcement officials, and knocked on over 10,000 doors.
I'm an outsider. I've never run for political office before. However, my family and many others across our district live with the consequences of failed policies and leadership in Washington, DC, every day.
In April of 2022, my wife Kathy and I lost our son Joey to fentanyl poisoning, a story that has become all too common. We are running to put our grief into action. It's our mission to ensure that no other Indiana family will have to go through what we have.
We will not stop until we accomplish this mission.
As an outsider, I am honored to have the support of law enforcement leaders from all across our district.
---
|
---
| I am also very grateful to have the endorsement of America First conservative Vivek Ramaswamy.
But now, the decision is in your hands. There has been a lot of negativity on the airwaves, in your mailboxes, and in your texts, but I committed on Day One that I would stay focused on what I had to offer to our district, not tear down my opponents.
I'm not running against anyone. I am running because we need people who have skin in the game to fight for all of us. And that is my commitment.
Tomorrow, I humbly ask for your vote for Congress.
To Victory,
Jamison Carrier Republican Candidate for Congress (IN-06)

name: Sarah McBride
subject: The path to federal paid leave
body:
No worker should be forced to choose between their family or their job.
#
_No worker — no matter where they live or work — should be forced to choose between their family or their job, their health or their paycheck._
That’s why as State Senator, I spearheaded the historic effort to pass paid family and medical leave in Delaware. In Congress, I will stop at nothing to do the same.
But I can’t do this alone. [**Can you show your support for federal paid leave by signing our petition right now?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/support-paid-leave-for-all?source=em20240506&t=1&akid=289%2E21716%2E-Ue0LU)
**[Add your name »](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/support-paid-leave-for-all?source=em20240506&t=2&akid=289%2E21716%2E-Ue0LU)**
Whether it’s time to recover from a short-term illness or a long one, caring for a new child or an aging parent, everyone deserves paid time off from work. And they should never worry that it will mean missing a paycheck or losing their job.
**I know that paid leave policies can make all the difference because they did for me.** When I was caring for my husband Andy as he battled cancer, I could devote the time I needed to be with him before he passed because my employer was supportive and flexible — I was lucky.
But people across the country shouldn’t have to rely on luck in order to give their loved ones the care they deserve.
That’s why I’ll fight to guarantee that every American can take paid leave in Congress.
[**If you agree that working families need federal paid leave, add your name now.**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/support-paid-leave-for-all?source=em20240506&t=3&akid=289%2E21716%2E-Ue0LU)
**[Add your name »](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/support-paid-leave-for-all?source=em20240506&t=4&akid=289%2E21716%2E-Ue0LU)**
Thank you for all that you do!
Sarah McBride

This is the first big step in Rashida’s re-election and it’s thanks to supporters like you who are powering our campaign. Thanks to our growing field team who are knocking on doors and organizing events, we were able to collect and submit the needed signatures ahead of the deadline—from supporters in each community in the district. It’s important that our field operations are up and running now, because this is how we push back against a multi-million-dollar attack campaign. AIPAC and its network spent $1 million in 2022 on a campaign seeking to misconstrue Rashida’s record of advocating for her constituents and all marginalized people. This year they’ve already spent more than $100,000 on Islamophobic attacks against Rashida, and they’re trying to defeat other progressive lawmakers as well. We run robust grassroots re-election programs, connecting directly with district residents and prioritizing being rooted in the community. When Rashida is on the ballot, she also uplifts working class candidates and candidates of color who are demanding equal rights for all. | Rashida works closely with her constituents to craft policy, and she’s training other lawmakers on how to set up Neighborhood Service Centers in their congressional districts like she has in Michigan’s 12th. These centers help navigate government services, returning more than $5.5 million back to Rashida’s constituents in the form of Social Security and other benefits. When residents meet with Rashida in person, they’re 100% sold on her leadership―seeing how she delivers for her district and uplifts marginalized communities and working people. Recently, Rashida held events with older members of her district, hearing directly from them on their needs, and then bringing their voices back to Congress to advocate for policies that address a lack of housing, hunger, homecare, and more. But with attacks from anti-Palestinian group AIPAC and their allies against Rashida and other progressive legislators, we need the resources to not just respond, but to get out in front of these ugly attacks. That’s exactly why we’re organized and on the ground, meeting with voters every day―empowering residents, listening to their concerns, and ensuring we all have the resources we need to not only survive, but thrive. Through her PAC, Rashida also supports other candidates who are similarly invested in their constituents, because that’s how we build a government that works for everyday people. When the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade, they took away the right for half of the population to access the health care they need. It's discrimination based on sex — plain and simple. **Adding the ERA to our Constitution would give us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights across the entire country.**
Right now, we're closer than ever before to certifying the ERA: 38 states have ratified it, and it's just one signature away from being added to the Constitution. _But an arbitrary deadline is stopping us from finally certifying this amendment!_
**That's why Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand introduced legislation that would establish that this deadline should _not_ stop us from certifying the ERA.** With bipartisan support and filibuster reform, we can pass this legislation, finally establish gender equality in our Constitution and restore reproductive freedoms nationwide.
This is a crucial moment in our fight for gender equality and reproductive rights. Kirsten needs to know where grassroots activists like you stand on the ERA. **[_Please, will you add your name before midnight tonight to show Kirsten that you support the ERA? Jared Moskowitz (D-FL) is back in hot water _again_ for [posting racist comments](https://substack.com/redirect/ec346420-60ea-4157-b3e0-5942f378fa9c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Twitter using his official account.
I began writing this post last week about the disastrous bill Moskowitz sponsored and helped get passed by Republicans in Congress (HR 6090).
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..3KixJLs3GqydPemb12jVvMtm_ylbEX9xVEicL4D06Fg?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144381676)
Now that Moskowitz is yet again tweeting out racist comments, it's time to push it out, even if it's not in its final, polished version.
HR 6090 was drafted by a handful of Republicans plus one very problematic Democrat - Jared Moskowitz of Florida.
So let's talk about Jared Moskowitz.
We knew Moskowitz was already in trouble with _someone_ because Politico[ was trying to fluff his career](https://substack.com/redirect/59d5572a-5f36-4b50-b448-a9eb0471ac5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the [same way they did DeSantis](https://substack.com/redirect/eafd142d-43f7-4a9c-959c-024e37c530cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) last week.
BOTH of the PR pieces that came out last week were written by Politico reporter Gary Fineout - the DeSantis mouthpiece and cheerleader who makes a side-hustle by taking money from the DeSantis administration ([among other groups and people](https://substack.com/redirect/800f2402-64a6-41e9-a722-675ccce5d5d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) in exchange for his positive coverage.
Now, he's fluffing Moskowitz.
So let's talk about Moskowitz and why he is bad news for democrats.
Moskowitz received his last two appointments because of his close relationships with [Matt Gaetz ](https://substack.com/redirect/d7a87532-ef45-46a7-9409-ddee7e4be065?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)and [Ron DeSantis](https://substack.com/redirect/d4d30990-9d3e-42bc-94d2-11132c02f6b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and has supported Republican legislation and conspiracy theories in Congress during his first term - including [joining Matt Gaetz for the very serious, not all embarrassing, totally legitimate UFO hearings.](https://substack.com/redirect/25517df4-4c7a-4a5a-95a4-4ff0ba82914a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Moskowitz and[ Gaetz](https://substack.com/redirect/c1f003a0-5a67-44a4-af2b-5ff4f3fb1706?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) were part of a group of state legislators in Florida[ known](https://substack.com/redirect/4dbb7cbf-84e4-4b75-8796-4739a3cc0a76?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for drugs, alcohol and parties with younger women. When revelations about Gaetz' behavior exploded in January 2021, Moskowitz repeatedly defended his friend and even posed the question "Is there really a difference between 17 and 18?"
You might be wondering - how did a man with such unsavory friends and a history of being sex-trafficking-adjacent and defending sex between adults and minors end up in Congress?
**Again - Matt Gaetz.**
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..3KixJLs3GqydPemb12jVvMtm_ylbEX9xVEicL4D06Fg?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144381676)
Gaetz ran DeSantis' 2018 transition team and got Moskowitz the head position at the Florida Department of Emergency Management (DEM), where Moskowitz oversaw one of the worst responses to the COVID-19 pandemic in the nation.
The warning signs were out there from the beginning.
Moskowitz [spread conspiracy theories about COVID-19](https://substack.com/redirect/a7fd4059-7b57-4293-8849-2833bac0b241?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) - during and after his time as the head of the agency managing the response - and made overtly racist comments about DeSantis' political appointees.
In early 2021, after media agencies [exposed](https://substack.com/redirect/71715227-06bb-427e-bd2d-507f531c3f2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the "pay for play" deals DeSantis made with wealthy Republican donors for early vaccine access - [which Moskowitz claims he personally managed and approved ](https://substack.com/redirect/520a8ddf-53b6-40db-bc2d-16cf34c71dfe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)- Moskowitz [resigned ](https://substack.com/redirect/8d60cb21-5bed-4389-bc04-4c55d147d537?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)as the head of DEM, but stayed on to "help with the transition" for several months. _(A year later, Moskowitz t[old a completely different story](https://substack.com/redirect/17bee13e-e87e-4120-8877-55f44cc5bfd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in which he had "nothing to do" with the vaccine distribution)._
Two months after he announced his resignation, the[ Miami Herald outed Moskowitz as a source for DeSantis' biggest and loudest political enemy](https://substack.com/redirect/fd5140be-3505-4a03-8a36-741f5f5d4187?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (moi).
Moskowitz tried to do damage control ([again using Gary Fineout at Politico](https://substack.com/redirect/75763c24-8cf2-4a5e-9346-c90907109c73?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)), but after the Miami Herald published a full string of texts from Moskowitz, the fallout for him was brutal and he slinked away for five months. No one would work with him. He lobbied hard to get figurehead appointments - eventually being put on an advisory board of one Florida county's COVID-19 task force five months later - but Moskowitz' career looked dead in the water.
So Moskowitz started rehabbing his image by appearing on podcasts with Christina Pushaw, Bryan Griffin and Jeremy Redfern - [DeSantis' notorious far-right social media terrorists](https://substack.com/redirect/34f2e7f1-246a-4b30-aefd-e511d97dd041?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9116a88a-a911-4a58-b7bd-44cf694d9b21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
His loyalties to DeSantis clear, Moskowitz' only chance of a comeback would depend on a favor from DeSantis. And that's exactly what he got.
In November 2021, [DeSantis appointed Moskowitz to the Broward County Board of Commissioners](https://substack.com/redirect/8ea05945-d8d7-4d6c-b1ed-4e023d65f7b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) - the launchpad from which Moskowitz made his congressional bid in a heated and contested primary in which Moskowitz notably refused to condemn any of DeSantis' policies.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3d80ffc5-c12b-4058-9dac-09df8198f89b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
To narrowly win his primary, Moskowitz became the only Democrat running for Congress to accept campaign donations from some of the most corrupt Republican financers in American politics - including [deceased sex trafficker Kent Stermon](https://substack.com/redirect/10fc6de0-b717-4713-9638-907eead96832?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (who Ron DeSantis lived with for a time in Tampa). He was only the only Democrat that [Republican super donor Ken Griffin](https://substack.com/redirect/2e008bfa-7669-48bc-bec7-dc7e390f8771?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (DeSantis' largest financier) gave to.
Despite the dark Republican money, despite only 1% of his total fundraising coming from small-dollar donors (the lowest among Democrats running that cycle for any state), the cover he gets from Republicans in exchange for his loyalty and Democrats who either don't know better or are just like him has somehow managed to inoculate him from consequences.
Voters need to impose some consequences for Moskowitz. And if they don't, party leadership should put him promptly put him in his place, because he's not only undermining our democratic institutions and helping the furthest-right GOP members of the House, he's embarrassing the party.
Moskowitz wrote a bill to[ rename a federal facility after Donald Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/6de6db3c-c2d3-48be-8b7c-614fb22c076c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), directed sexist and violent statements at his female colleagues in Congress [(including a tweet telling AOC to "fuck off")](https://substack.com/redirect/63faa349-b289-40fb-a7ff-53305f10498b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), posted a bizarre [sexual video of Joe Biden staring at a woman's breasts](https://substack.com/redirect/9ba410ad-6133-4c44-985e-3f5f1dce0993?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and today posted a [racist comment about Koreans eating dogs](https://substack.com/redirect/ec346420-60ea-4157-b3e0-5942f378fa9c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
On the scale of left-right ideology, [Moskowitz' voting records puts him nearly dead center in Congress](https://substack.com/redirect/b3a8386a-4e38-4411-8247-a4d9cc4aeb9b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but he continues to masquerade as a progressive.
He voted against global warming mitigation. He voted with the GOP in condemning Biden's administration on immigration - including [voting "Yea"](https://substack.com/redirect/c41c380a-5ed0-4533-9e0c-8aadc80df46a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the GOP bill to condemn Biden's "open borders" policy. He has voted more in line with the most extreme members of Congress than any other sitting democrat.
His record is only saved by the fact that he has[ missed twice the average number of votes compared to the rest of Congress](https://substack.com/redirect/0c13b212-09e0-447a-9585-ed4cec5c0f54?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
All of that is important context in understanding how a bill that is in flagrant violation of the First Amendment and seeks to cripple American universities gets sponsored by a "democrat."
And I'll discuss that bill more later this week.

It’s about restoring the same compassionate leadership that gave my family a shot at the American Dream.

| [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84453737/471551887/-1141683812?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDkyOTIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTIwZGVkMzItZjgwYi1lZjExLTk2ZjMtN2MxZTUyMWIwN2Y5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=yrqquZ6WEyS-yLDWz0mBHDMLYKmNLiY6SAy5XlcQgN4=&emci=a79102c5-d50b-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=520ded32-f80b-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=23786099)

| | **It’s no exaggeration to say that service to this country is in my blood.** Back in the 1960s, my parents were living in Laos at the height of the Vietnam War. As the conflict raged on, my father worked with the U.S. Agency for International Development to deliver supplies to communities displaced by the war — helping countless people in the process. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84453757/471551901/620705008?refcode=E8345-20240506-LanonStory-Image-PersonalFromPrinciple&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDkyOTIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTIwZGVkMzItZjgwYi1lZjExLTk2ZjMtN2MxZTUyMWIwN2Y5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=yrqquZ6WEyS-yLDWz0mBHDMLYKmNLiY6SAy5XlcQgN4=) My father's efforts aiding the Americans on the frontlines made him a marked man. And were it not for former Governor Bob Ray spearheading the relocation of over 3,000 refugees — including my father, mother, and four sisters — my family probably wouldn’t be in Iowa today. **That’s why, at 17 years old, I joined the Iowa Army National Guard. Having survived a war, my parents were concerned about my enlistment, but co-signed my papers because they knew how important it was to me to give back to the country that gave us so much.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84453803/471551942/620705008?refcode=E8345-20240506-LanonStory-Image-PersonalFromPrinciple&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDkyOTIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTIwZGVkMzItZjgwYi1lZjExLTk2ZjMtN2MxZTUyMWIwN2Y5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=yrqquZ6WEyS-yLDWz0mBHDMLYKmNLiY6SAy5XlcQgN4=) Peter, my family was grateful for the community we grew up with in Mt. Pleasant, Iowa, and a love for our country developed in me from an early age. **And it hasn’t wavered since.** **My service to this country isn’t about winning an election. It’s about restoring the same compassionate leadership, building strong communities, and strengthening our connections to each other that allowed my family to plant our roots in Iowa.** **[I’m running for Congress because my American Dream was made possible right here in Iowa. And now, it’s time for us to have strong, proven leadership to help others achieve theirs. »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84453804/471551972/1986179464?refcode=E8345-20240506-LanonStory-SL-PersonalFromPrinciple&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDkyOTIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTIwZGVkMzItZjgwYi1lZjExLTk2ZjMtN2MxZTUyMWIwN2Y5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=yrqquZ6WEyS-yLDWz0mBHDMLYKmNLiY6SAy5XlcQgN4=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [DONATE $5](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84453805/471551973/1986179464?express_lane=true&&refcode=E8345-20240506-LanonStory-EG-PersonalfromPrincipal&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDkyOTIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTIwZGVkMzItZjgwYi1lZjExLTk2ZjMtN2MxZTUyMWIwN2Y5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=yrqquZ6WEyS-yLDWz0mBHDMLYKmNLiY6SAy5XlcQgN4=)
